title: Which LLM is Best for Translating Natural Language Goals to PDDL
summary: Bridging the gap between human intent and machine execution remains a challenge in automated planning, where expressing goals in formal languages like PDDL restricts accessibility to non-experts. This paper empirically evaluates whether current Large Language Models (LLMs) can reliably translate natural language testing goals, written in informal language by video game testers, into well-formed PDDL targets suitable for classical planning. We present a carefully designed prompt template, integrating insights from iterative experimentation, aimed at maximizing both accuracy and response coherence from multiple state-of-the-art LLMs. Six contemporary models are systematically assessed on correctness, speed, and error tendencies using real-world, domain-specific benchmarks. All models demonstrate high correctness, exceeding 92\%, with Gemini 2.5 Flash achieving the highest accuracy at 96\% and the lowest incidence of false positives, while GPT-4.1 leads in response speed. Despite these advances, critical distinctions exist in model performance, and occasional failures arise from language ambiguity and limitations in domain representation. Our analysis underscores both the significant progress and ongoing gaps in enabling LLMs to act as robust bridges between natural language objectives and automated planning pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文实证评估了当前主流大语言模型能否将电子游戏测试者用非正式自然语言表述的测试目标，可靠地翻译为可用于经典规划的良好形式PDDL目标，通过设计提示模板对六个模型进行正确性、速度与错误倾向的系统测试。
AI.motivation: 自动规划中，人类意图与机器执行之间存在鸿沟：使用PDDL等形式化语言表达目标，对非专家而言门槛过高。作者希望验证LLM是否能充当自然语言目标与自动规划流程之间的可靠桥梁，从而降低规划系统的使用门槛。
AI.method: 作者基于迭代实验的经验，设计了一个精心构造的提示模板，以最大化多个先进LLM在准确性与响应连贯性上的表现；选取六个当代模型，在真实的、领域特定的基准上，从正确率、响应速度和错误倾向三个维度进行系统评估。
AI.result: 所有模型的正确率均超过92%；其中Gemini 2.5 Flash准确率最高，达96%，且假阳性出现率最低；GPT-4.1在响应速度上领先。模型性能之间仍存在关键差异，偶发失败主要源于语言歧义与领域表示能力的局限。
AI.conclusion: 研究既肯定了LLM在连接自然语言目标与自动规划管线方面取得的显著进展，也指出了仍待弥补的不足，表明LLM作为“稳健桥梁”尚存改进空间。

title: Evolutionary Ensemble Search: Council-Guided Program Evolution with Persistent Memory
summary: Evolutionary Ensemble Search (EES) constructs machine-learning procedures through expert-guided program evolution. A role-specialized council turns task evidence and experimental results into structured search directions. An orchestrator allocates these directions to execution specialists and an evolutionary engine. The engine selects measured parents, diagnoses their errors, and produces descendants through code mutation, structured pipeline edits, and crossover. Each child must execute and acquire its own validation evidence. Population archives retain useful alternatives, while compatible predictions compete in a validation-gated ensemble stage. Search adapts through parent-relative operator credit, session memory, and problem-indexed lessons retrieved across runs. We specify these mechanisms, distinguish their execution profiles, and define the contracts required to compare candidates as their computations change. A public MLE-bench Lite development ledger records medal-threshold artifacts on 19 of 22 tasks (86.36\%), with best outcomes of 11 gold, five silver, and three bronze. The procedures span text, images, tables, audio, scientific geometry, and deterministic transformations. The campaign includes grade feedback between runs, external-source routes, and mixed confirmation procedures; its aggregate is an achieved development result, not a blind autonomous-agent success rate. The report contributes a concrete architecture for cumulative executable search and a versioned account of its cross-modal development outcomes.

AI.tldr: EES通过专家引导的程序演化构建机器学习流程，采用角色分工的委员会生成搜索方向、编排器调度执行专家与演化引擎，并以验证证据门控集成与存档，在MLE-bench Lite上22个任务中19个达到奖牌阈值（86.36%），最佳为11金5银3铜。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习流程构建多依赖人工专家试错，难以系统化累积跨任务与跨模态的可执行经验。本文旨在提出一种可累积、可执行、以证据驱动的自动化搜索架构，使程序演化过程中的候选解能够在计算结构变化时仍被公平比较。
AI.method: 核心机制包括四层：(1) 角色专业化委员会将任务证据与实验结果转化为结构化搜索方向；(2) 编排器把方向分配给执行专家和演化引擎；(3) 演化引擎选择已测量的父代、诊断其错误，并通过代码变异、结构化流水线编辑与交叉生成子代，每个子代必须实际执行并获得自身验证证据；(4) 种群存档保留有效备选方案，兼容的预测在验证门控的集成阶段竞争。搜索本身通过父代相对算子绩效、会话记忆以及跨运行检索的问题索引化经验进行自适应。文中还明确区分各机制的执行画像，并定义在候选计算发生变化时进行比较所需的契约。
AI.result: 在公开的MLE-bench Lite开发账本上，22个任务中有19个产生了达到奖牌阈值的成果，占86.36%；最佳结果为11枚金牌、5枚银牌和3枚铜牌。覆盖任务横跨文本、图像、表格、音频、科学几何以及确定性变换等多种模态。该活动还包含运行间的等级反馈、外部来源路径和混合确认流程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作报告了一个面向累积式可执行搜索的具体架构，并给出其跨模态开发成果的版本化记录。作者强调：账本中的总体成绩是已实现的开发结果，而非盲测自主智能体的成功率；其贡献在于可复用的架构设计、明确的比较契约以及可追溯的开发证据记录。

title: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models as Surrogates in Expensive Evolutionary Optimization
summary: Surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms (SAEAs) are effective methods for solving expensive optimization problems (EOPs), where surrogate models replace most expensive evaluations and critically influence the final optimization results. In recent years, tabular foundation models have advanced rapidly, and the Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) has been adopted as a surrogate model for EOPs due to its strong predictive capability, demonstrating promising performance. Motivated by its potential as a surrogate model in SAEAs, this work conducts a comprehensive study that combines extensive experiments with in-depth theoretical analysis to investigate the effectiveness of TabPFN. Specifically, we perform experiments across both offline and online SAEA settings, covering diverse problem scenarios such as single-objective, multi-objective, constrained, combinatorial, mixed-variable, and engineering optimization problems. In addition, we further analyze the advantages and limitations of TabPFN within SAEAs and provide practical guidelines for its application in different optimization settings. Results show that the effectiveness of TabPFN is highly problem dependent, and it cannot replace conventional surrogates universally. Overall, TabPFN should be adopted selectively according to data availability, landscape complexity, search space characteristics, and its role within the algorithm. Customized model management strategies and role-specific algorithm design are necessary to fully exploit its advantages and avoid its pitfalls.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大量实验与理论分析，系统研究了TabPFN作为代理模型在代理辅助进化算法（SAEAs）中的有效性，发现其效果高度依赖问题类型，无法普遍替代传统代理模型。
AI.motivation: 代理模型在求解昂贵优化问题（EOPs）的SAEAs中起关键作用，而TabPFN凭借强大预测能力已被用作EOPs的代理模型并展现潜力，因此有必要系统评估其在SAEAs中的实际效果与适用边界。
AI.method: 在离线和在线SAEA两种设置下开展广泛实验，覆盖单目标、多目标、约束、组合、混合变量及工程优化等多类问题场景，并结合深入的理论分析，考察TabPFN的优势与局限。
AI.result: TabPFN的有效性高度依赖于具体问题，不能普遍替代传统代理模型；其表现受数据可用性、适应度景观复杂度、搜索空间特征及算法中角色等因素影响。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN应依据具体优化设置选择性采用，并需要定制化的模型管理策略与角色特定的算法设计，才能充分发挥其优势、规避其不足；文中还提供了实践指南。

title: A Metaheuristic Optimization Framework for Discrete Optimization under Strict Time Limits
summary: Real-time applications often rely on optimization approaches that can find high-quality solutions to hard problems on the order of milliseconds. Metaheuristic optimization frameworks (MOFs) are useful tools for such tasks, as they provide large sets of general-purpose search mechanisms that can return solutions under different computational budgets. However, existing work largely overlooks the available computation time as an explicit dimension of analysis. In this work, we introduce STILO, a MOF specifically designed for optimization under strict time limits. STILO integrates fine-grained configuration spaces for ant colony optimization (ACO), genetic algorithm (GA), and simulated annealing (SA), combining existing and novel operators. We performed experiments using both synthetic and benchmark instances of various discrete optimization problems. The results indicate that the proposed discrete distance calculation mechanism for SA is useful for optimization under strict time limits. They also show that the relative effectiveness of the proposed problem-independent graph structures for ACO can vary across time limits, even for the same instance characteristics. More generally, the results demonstrate that the effectiveness of algorithm families and operators depends not only on the problem type, but also on the characteristics of the instance and the available computational budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STILO——一个面向严格时间限制的元启发式优化框架，集成 ACO、GA 与 SA 的细粒度配置空间及新算子，实验表明算法与算子的有效性依赖于问题类型、实例特征及可用计算预算。
AI.motivation: 实时应用需要在毫秒级内求解困难问题并保证高质量解，元启发式优化框架（MOF）虽能提供通用搜索机制，但现有研究大多将可用计算时间视为隐含变量，未将其作为显式分析维度，导致难以针对严格时间预算选择合适算法与算子。
AI.method: 提出 STILO，一个专为严格时间限制下优化设计的元启发式优化框架。该框架为蚁群优化（ACO）、遗传算法（GA）和模拟退火（SA）集成了细粒度配置空间，融合已有算子与新型算子；其中包含面向 SA 的离散距离计算机制，以及面向 ACO 的与问题无关的图结构。在多种离散优化问题的合成实例与基准实例上开展实验。
AI.result: 实验表明：所提出的 SA 离散距离计算机制在严格时间限制下对优化有效；所提出的 ACO 问题无关图结构在不同时间限制下的相对有效性会变化，即使实例特征相同亦然。总体而言，算法族与算子的有效性不仅取决于问题类型，还取决于实例特征与可用计算预算。
AI.conclusion: 可用计算时间应作为优化分析的显式维度；在严格时间限制场景中，算法族与算子的选择需结合问题类型、实例特征及计算预算综合考量，STILO 为此类分析与实践提供了统一框架。

relevance.reason: 提出面向严格时间限制的元启发式优化框架STILO，集成ACO、GA、SA及算子配置，属于自动化算法设计与组合优化方向。

title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures; includes references and supplementary material
summary: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed target agent. Task holdout varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a "bad genius" Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose released-benchmark gain depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution (CHASE), which casts harness evolution as constraint generation over validity-preserving benchmark counterfactuals. After each Proposer update, a Challenger searches for an executable protocol transformation with large gain destruction. A validity firewall checks that task semantics are preserved, while a confirmation set determines whether the counterfactual enters a finite archive. We formalize an exact shortcut-neutralized benchmark $B_0$ and establish statistical guarantees linking finite counterfactual archives to $B_0$ and characterizing sequential Challenger search. We evaluate CHASE on a synthetic benchmark and on OfficeQA, where CHASE retains strong released-benchmark gains while substantially reducing gain destruction under valid protocol changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CHASE，将自动 harness 优化中的评测可靠性问题建模为约束生成，通过 Challenger 搜索保持语义的 benchmark 反事实变换来识别并抵消 benchmark 级别的捷径，从而获得对 $B_0$ 更稳健的 harness 评估。
AI.motivation: 自动 harness 优化会反复利用已发布 benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ 指导 Proposer 修改 prompt、memory、retrieval、tool 与 control code，使开发出的 harness 可能依赖 benchmark-wide shortcut 产生虚假增益。传统 task holdout 只改变语义任务，协议固定，无法排除这类"bad genius"式作弊，因此需要新的评测机制。
AI.method: CHASE 将 harness evolution 视为对保持有效性的 benchmark 反事实的约束生成。每次 Proposer 更新后，Challenger 搜索能大幅破坏增益的可执行协议变换；validity firewall 检查任务语义是否保持，confirmation set 决定反事实是否进入有限 archive。作者形式化 shortcut-neutralized benchmark $B_0$，并给出将有限反事实 archive 与 $B_0$ 关联的统计保证，以及顺序 Challenger 搜索的刻画。
AI.result: 在合成 benchmark 与 OfficeQA 上评估，CHASE 在保留较强 released-benchmark 增益的同时，显著降低了在有效协议变化下的 gain destruction。
AI.conclusion: CHASE 通过反事实协议搜索与有效性防火墙，为自动 harness 优化提供了更可靠的评测框架，缓解了 benchmark-wide shortcut 带来的作弊风险。

title: Compiled Agency: Frontier General-Purpose Coding Agents Build Winning Game Players from Bare Interaction - from Flappy Bird to StarCraft II and Civilization
summary: LLM agents have repeatedly struggled to convert knowledge of a game into competent play, even when researchers build the agent around the model - supplying perception, memory, skill libraries, planners, or executable-policy scaffolds. Rapid progress in coding agents raises two sharper questions: can frontier models now win games at all, and can they win them unaided, building the entire player themselves? We introduce Gauntlet, a develop-freeze-evaluate framework that ports games from small arcades to full commercial-scale titles, behind one deliberately bare contract: a general-purpose coding agent receives a game description, a raw observation/action interface, and an empty policy file - no strategy, no algorithm, no architecture. In a single autonomous session the agent experiments with the live game and engineers a standalone controller; we freeze the result and score it on held-out instances with zero model calls during play. On an unpublished procedural roguelike, held-out success spans 0-86 percent and exposes a sharp generational threshold: every observed session of a newest-generation system outperforms the best session of its predecessor. At full-game scale, a compiled raw-API controller defeats every fair StarCraft II built-in AI and two cheating variants, and single-session programs win complete games of Civilization (Freeciv) by total conquest on held-out seeds. Though at modest rates against novice AI, this is a first: no prior language-agent system had won full games of this genre standalone, without per-turn model calls and a hand-crafted tactical layer. Frontier coding agents begin to track long-horizon strategy. The frozen programs are inspectable. We call this capability compiled agency: development experience compiled into a persistent executable agent whose architecture is built by the model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gauntlet 框架：让通用编码智能体仅凭游戏描述、原始观测/动作接口和空策略文件，在单次自主会话中自建完整玩家程序，冻结后零模型调用评测，在 roguelike、星际争霸 II 与 Freeciv 上首次实现独立通关。
AI.motivation: 以往 LLM 智能体即使配备感知、记忆、技能库、规划器或可执行策略脚手架，仍难以将游戏知识转化为有竞争力的操作；编码智能体的快速进展引出两个问题：前沿模型现在能否赢下游戏，以及能否在无辅助条件下自行构建完整玩家。
AI.method: Gauntlet 采用"开发—冻结—评测"框架，覆盖从小型街机到完整商业规模的游戏，遵循极简契约：通用编码智能体只获得游戏描述、原始观测/动作接口和空策略文件，不含策略、算法或架构。智能体在单次自主会话中与实时游戏交互实验，自行工程化一个独立控制器；随后冻结该结果，在留出实例上评分，游玩过程零模型调用。
AI.result: 在未公开的程序化 roguelike 上，留出成功率介于 0–86%，并呈现明显的代际阈值：最新一代系统的每个观测会话均超过上一代最佳会话。在完整游戏规模下，编译后的原始 API 控制器击败所有公平的《星际争霸 II》内置 AI 及两个作弊变体；单次会话程序在留出种子上以全面征服方式赢得完整《文明》（Freeciv）对局。尽管对新手 AI 胜率不高，但这是首次：此前无任何语言智能体系统能在无逐回合模型调用与手工战术层的条件下独立赢下该类型完整对局。
AI.conclusion: 前沿编码智能体开始具备长时程策略能力。冻结程序可被审查。作者将这一能力称为"编译式能动性"（compiled agency）：把开发经验编译为持久可执行智能体，其架构由模型自行构建。

title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
summary: In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates. However, we uncover a systematic failure mode in PPO critics, which we call Value Flattening: state values, estimated from multiple Monte Carlo continuations, change sharply across intermediate states while critic predictions remain comparatively flat. We further observe this phenomenon in a controlled FrozenLake environment and find that it becomes more pronounced as the state space grows. Our theoretical and empirical analyses relate Value Flattening to an implicit variance penalty in the critic loss and redundant updates from temporally correlated states with similar gradients. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP$^3$O), which applies the value loss to only a few well-separated states in each response to mitigate both effects. Experiments on Qwen3-Base show that SP$^3$O with only three states supervised per response can mitigate Value Flattening and consistently improve the learned policy across model sizes and evaluation suites. Together, our results identify Value Flattening as an important yet overlooked failure mode of critic learning in standard PPO and show that a simple sparse supervision strategy can mitigate it.

AI.tldr: 本文发现PPO中critic存在"Value Flattening"失效模式（中间状态价值剧变但预测平坦），并从理论与实证角度归因于隐式方差惩罚与相关状态的冗余更新，提出稀疏监督方法SP³O缓解该问题并提升策略表现。
AI.motivation: PPO通常依赖critic估计状态价值以降低策略更新方差，但critic学习本身存在被忽视的失效模式，影响价值估计准确性与策略优化效果，作者希望揭示并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出SParse Proximal Policy Optimization（SP³O），在每条response中仅对少量、相互间隔较远的"良分离"状态施加价值损失，从而同时缓解隐式方差惩罚和时间相关状态带来的冗余更新两种效应。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base上，每条response仅监督三个状态即可缓解Value Flattening，并在不同模型规模和评测套件上持续提升所学策略；在受控FrozenLake环境中该现象随状态空间增大更明显。
AI.conclusion: Value Flattening是标准PPO中critic学习的重要且被忽视的失效模式，简单的稀疏监督策略即可有效缓解，为价值估计稳定性与策略优化提供了新视角。

relevance.reason: 针对LLM强化学习中PPO评估器价值平坦化问题提出稀疏监督策略，属于LLM+RL核心方向。
relevance.title_zh: 重新思考PPO中的评估器学习：理解与缓解价值平坦化

title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost
summary: Agentic AI systems often approach the same task through multiple workflows that differ in reasoning strategy, verification structure, and compute cost. A natural deployment policy is to use the workflow with the highest average performance, but this can be suboptimal because different workflows may succeed on different instances. We study a portfolio-and-selector paradigm in which a firm runs multiple workflow executions and selects the final answer after observing their outputs. Additional executions may uncover correct answers that the best standalone workflow misses, but they consume compute and introduce plausible distractors that complicate final selection. We formulate this as a workflow portfolio problem in which the firm jointly chooses run size and allocation across workflow types. We summarize selector quality through an odds-lift index and derive sharp bounds on the value of workflow variety. For finite workflow pools, we develop exact formulations, linear programming relaxations, randomized rounding procedures, and computable performance certificates. For large implicit workflow classes, we derive a finite-dimensional dual and an ellipsoid method using a pricing oracle to identify workflows with high weighted accuracy net of recurring compute cost. Under a weak condition, the method obtains a near-optimal solution to the relaxation with polynomially many oracle calls. We evaluate the framework on three datasets: ABCD, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and HotpotQA. title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
summary: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. Run several of them and each session starts from scratch, so more agents tend to mean more duplicated search rather than more discovery. Agora is a shared memory for such agents: research is recorded as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) stored in Git, so that every claim is a commit anyone can check out and rerun. Each result, insight, hypothesis, verification, and report is an immutable commit whose parent edges say what it builds on; a derived index exposes the frontier, the neglected branches, and the verification status of each claim, and a diversity-aware selection rule keeps the community from collapsing onto one leader. We describe the system and report its first sustained use: a run of nearly 12 days in which 13 language-model workers, with no assigned tasks and no central planner, worked on a weight-transfer problem. Given 141 pretrained donor models and a frozen 119.6M-parameter attention-SSM hybrid whose dimensions match no donor, the workers had to initialize the target without training data or gradient updates. They published 1,703 contributions and drove the evaluator from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M. The winning recipe compresses donor next-token statistics into the target's embedding and output head, then adds a short-range context signal through sparse edits to attention, feed-forward, and state-space blocks. Its 145-commit ancestry spans 15 accounts, and 165 independent reproductions were posted, none of which failed. We describe the single mid-run human intervention that pulled the community out of a monoculture, what the trace does and does not establish, and the controlled comparison that would settle whether shared research state improves discovery per unit of compute.

AI.tldr: Agora 是一个基于 Git 的有向无环图（DAG）共享研究记忆系统，使多个自主研究智能体能够累积式协作，而非重复劳动。在一项持续近 12 天的真实运行中，13 个无中央调度的语言模型工作节点在无训练数据、无梯度更新的条件下解决了权重迁移问题，将评估指标从 3.39 降至 1.899 bits per byte，弥补了与训练过的 GPT-2 124M 之间 62% 的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有自主研究循环（如 AutoResearch）中，每个智能体独立从头开始搜索，导致多个智能体并行时更多是搜索重复而非发现增量。作者希望设计一种共享研究状态机制，使多智能体能够基于彼此成果累积推进，提升单位算力的发现效率。
AI.method: Agora 将研究过程记录为仅追加的有向无环图（DAG），存储于 Git 中，每个论断对应一个不可变提交（commit）；父边表示其依赖关系，使任何论断都可被检出并复现。系统覆盖结果、洞见、假设、验证和报告等提交类型，并通过派生索引暴露研究前沿、被忽视分支及各论断的验证状态；同时采用多样性感知的选择规则，防止群体收敛于单一主导方向。研究在权重迁移任务上展开：给定 141 个预训练供体模型和一个冻结的 119.6M 参数注意力-SSM 混合目标模型（维度与任何供体均不匹配），工作节点须在无训练数据、无梯度更新的条件下初始化目标模型。
AI.result: 运行近 12 天，13 个语言模型工作节点在无任务分配、无中央规划者的情况下共发布 1,703 项贡献，将评估器指标从 3.39 降至 1.899 bits per byte，弥补了与训练过的 GPT-2 124M 之间 62% 的差距。获胜方案将供体的下一词元统计压缩进目标的嵌入层和输出头，并通过稀疏编辑注意力、前馈和状态空间块注入短程上下文信号；其 145 次提交的谱系跨越 15 个账户，共发布 165 次独立复现，无一失败。
AI.conclusion: Agora 展示了共享研究状态在多智能体自主研究中的可行性，在无中央调度条件下实现了持续累积式发现。作者还描述了运行中一次将社区拉出单一文化（monoculture）的人类干预，并讨论了该轨迹所能与不能证明的结论，以及需要通过受控对比实验来验证共享研究状态是否真正提升单位算力的发现效率。

title: WetRobo: A Reproducible Robot Kit for Coding Agents in Biological Laboratories

Vision-language-action policies have been proposed for general-purpose arms, but can lose performance when their operating environment changes. We therefore built WetRobo, a robot kit that can readily transfer between laboratories. It consists of one robot arm, laboratory equipment (an incubator, a reagent bottle with a cap, and a Petri dish), the existing code that moves the arm, teleoperation demonstrations of each task that we recorded, and a general AGENTS.md skill file. A biological experimentalist provides natural-language tasks without collecting local teleoperation training data or training a neural network. The coding agent observes the local laboratory and writes and executes programs, using external tools as needed for adaptation. title: Reasoning through Evolution: Automatic Meta-path Discovery for LLM-based Fake News Detection
summary: Propagation structures provide crucial evidence for fake news detection, yet existing approaches primarily rely on supervised GNN-based models, which require substantial labeled data and exhibit limited generalization. Although large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, directly feeding them raw propagation graphs creates a significant modality mismatch and severe information overload, making structure-aware reasoning unreliable in zero-shot and few-shot settings. To bridge this gap, we propose MAGER, a multi-agent genetic evolution framework that automatically discovers meta-paths optimized for LLM reasoning. By compressing complex propagation graphs into informative subgraphs, the evolved meta-paths alleviate both information overload and modality mismatch, enabling frozen LLMs to perform structure-aware veracity reasoning. We further introduce a graph in-context learning strategy that retrieves semantically and structurally similar demonstrations to strengthen classification and reasoning. Extensive experiments show that MAGER substantially improves frozen LLMs as standalone fake news detectors in data-efficient settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/SenticNet/MAGER.

title: Online Robust Reinforcement Learning Through Monte-Carlo Planning
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a powerful framework for solving complex decision-making problems, yet it often relies on the assumption that the simulator and the real-world dynamics are identical. Although this assumption helps achieve the success of MCTS in games like Chess, Go, and Shogi, the real-world scenarios incur ambiguity due to their modeling mismatches in low-fidelity simulators. In this work, we present a new robust variant of MCTS that mitigates dynamical model ambiguities. Our algorithm addresses transition dynamics and reward distribution ambiguities to bridge the gap between simulation-based planning and real-world deployment. We incorporate a robust power mean backup operator and carefully designed exploration bonuses to ensure finite-sample convergence at every node in the search tree. We show that our algorithm achieves a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$ for the value estimation at the root node, comparable to that of standard MCTS. Finally, we provide empirical evidence that our method achieves robust performance in planning problems even under significant ambiguity in the underlying reward distribution and transition dynamics.

title: Integrated Optimization of Automated Warehouse Operations and Last-Mile Transport for Differentiated On-Demand Delivery

For external optimization, we propose an improved algorithm based on a Multi-Reward, Multi Head attention-Heterogeneous Capacity Vehicle Routing Problem (MRMH-HCVRP) framework, which incorporates the optimized scheduling order sequence and grouping, combined with customer location, demand, and priority, vehicle capacity, speed, and service range. title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve decisions using interaction history, yet it remains unclear whether such improvement reflects refined internal reasoning or mere extrapolation of statistical patterns. To disentangle these mechanisms, we study LLM agents in multi-agent incomplete-information games that require recursive belief reasoning. By constructing a public goods game and manipulating the statistical structure of historical feedback, we evaluate decision quality against a history-independent rational expectations equilibrium (REE) benchmark. Our experiments reveal that when historical statistical patterns are disrupted, the benefits of longer context largely vanish, degrading decision quality to the no-context baseline in a way sharply amplified by stronger strategic interdependence. These results suggest that, in such strategic environments, ICL behavior is more consistent with statistical extrapolation than with strategic reasoning. Our work extends the mechanistic study of ICL to strategic multi-agent settings, introduces REE as a diagnostic tool for distinguishing reasoning from extrapolation, and provides a reusable framework for probing the boundaries of LLM reasoning in recursive belief tasks.

AI.tldr: 研究通过多智能体不完全信息博弈，将ICL的作用机制拆分为"内部推理精炼"与"统计模式外推"，发现ICL更符合统计外推而非策略推理。
AI.motivation: ICL能让LLM智能体利用交互历史改进决策，但其改进究竟源于内部推理的精炼，还是对统计模式的简单外推尚不明确，需设计机制以区分二者。
AI.method: 构建公共品博弈环境，要求递归信念推理；操控历史反馈的统计结构，并以与历史无关的理性预期均衡（REE）作为基准评估决策质量。
AI.result: 当历史统计模式被破坏时，更长上下文的收益基本消失，决策质量退化至无上下文基线，且该退化在策略相互依赖更强时被显著放大。
AI.conclusion: 在该类策略环境中，ICL行为更接近统计外推而非策略推理；研究将ICL机制研究拓展至多智能体策略场景，提出REE作为区分推理与外推的诊断工具，并提供可复用框架以探测LLM递归信念任务的推理边界。

title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.

AI.tldr: EvolveTrade 将工具型交易代理的系统提示视为文本参数化策略，通过策略代理利用决策轨迹与组合反馈持续修改该策略，在固定主干 LLM 的前提下提升跨市场状态下的夏普比率与累计收益。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 交易代理多依赖部署前手写固定的工具使用策略，难以在市场状态变化时自适应调整证据收集、工具调用、信号验证与风险管理方式。
AI.method: 提出 EvolveTrade 自演化框架：把工具型交易代理的系统提示当作文本参数化策略；每个更新周期后，由 Policy Agent 基于累积的决策轨迹与已实现组合反馈修订该策略，主干 LLM 保持冻结；更新后的策略用于下一批交易决策，从而迭代优化信息获取与组合构建流程。
AI.result: 在多种市场状态与两个 LLM 主干上的实验表明，EvolveTrade 在多数评估设置中相比固定策略 LLM 基线提升了夏普比率与累计收益；行为分析显示自演化策略增加了代码介导的分析并激活了与市场状态相关的计算；案例级"策略—收益"归因追踪了策略诱导的配置变化如何贡献于已实现收益差异。
AI.conclusion: 自适应调整治理工具使用的可复用流程，是构建更稳健 LLM 交易代理的关键方向。

title: The Cost of Becoming: Developmental Encoding Increases Phenotypic Diversity but Reduces Locality and Recombination Robustness in Evolved Robots
summary: Developmental encodings are often motivated by the expectation that a structured genotype-to-phenotype process can improve evolvability, robustness, and adaptation. Yet an encoding that expands phenotypic variation may simultaneously make useful parental structure harder to preserve under mutation and recombination. We test this trade-off in a controlled evolutionary-robotics benchmark comparing three matched representations: direct encoding, a static generative encoding, and a temporal zygotic developmental encoding. All three conditions use 34 genome parameters, 34 adult-controller parameters, identical initial genome matrices, the same optimizer, the same mutation and crossover operators, the same environments, and the same number of fitness evaluations. Across 30 paired evolutionary runs per representation, developmental encoding does not reliably exceed direct encoding in final training or out-of-distribution fitness. It does, however, substantially increase final population phenotypic diversity and mutant-reachable phenotype diversity. The same representation exhibits lower mutation viability, lower genotype--phenotype locality, sharply reduced crossover offspring fitness and viability, and increased recombination novelty. Continued developmental dynamics also attenuate damage applied early in development relative to otherwise identical late damage. These results identify a representation-level trade-off: development can enlarge the neighborhood of reachable phenotypes and provide within-development damage attenuation while degrading the local inheritance of already-adapted structure. We argue that developmental encodings should therefore be evaluated not by performance alone, but by a joint geometry of generativity, locality, robustness, and inheritance compatibility.

AI.tldr: 在严格配对的进化机器人基准中，发育编码并未在适应度上稳定超越直接编码，但显著提升表型多样性与发育期内损伤衰减，同时降低突变存活率、基因型-表型局部性与重组后代的适应度和存活率，揭示"生成性-局部性-稳健性-可继承性"的表示层权衡。
AI.motivation: 发育编码常被寄望通过结构化基因型-表型映射提升可进化性、稳健性与适应性，但扩张表型变异可能同时削弱对已有父代结构的保真。作者希望检验这一被假设存在却缺乏受控验证的权衡。
AI.method: 采用受控进化机器人基准，比较三种相互匹配的表示：直接编码、静态生成式编码、时序合子发育编码。三者在基因组参数数（34）、成体控制器参数数（34）、初始基因组矩阵、优化器、突变与交叉算子、环境及适应度评估次数上完全一致；每种表示执行30次配对进化运行，并测量最终与分布外适应度、种群及突变可达表型多样性、突变存活率、基因型-表型局部性、交叉后代适应度/存活率/重组新颖性，以及发育早期与晚期损伤的对比。
AI.result: 发育编码在最终训练与分布外适应度上未能稳定超过直接编码，但显著提高最终种群表型多样性与突变可达表型多样性。同一表示表现出更低的突变存活率、更低的基因型-表型局部性、明显降低的交叉后代适应度与存活率，以及更高的重组新颖性。此外，持续的发育动力学使发育早期的损伤相对于条件相同的晚期损伤被衰减。
AI.conclusion: 结果识别出表示层面的权衡：发育可扩大可达表型邻域并提供发育期内损伤衰减，却损害已适应结构的局部继承。因此发育编码不应仅以性能评估，而应以生成性、局部性、稳健性与可继承性的联合几何来评价。

title: GraphEcho: Structural Redundancy and Evidence Provenance in LLM Graph Agents
summary: A large language model (LLM) agent can follow more graph paths without acquiring more independent evidence. GraphEcho tests whether agents mistake these repeated encounters for additional corroboration. The benchmark varies path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed, and evaluates both judgments and active exploration. Controlled synthetic experiments reveal model-dependent judgment shifts, but redundant supporting paths increase the share of repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents. Provenance-aware post-training (PAPT) reduces revisits and improves synthetic accuracy, yet covers fewer distinct sources. On scientific claims, it continues to reduce repetition while accuracy declines. These findings expose a gap between efficient exploration and effective evidence use: an agent can learn to stop repeating itself while overlooking information it needs. GraphEcho provides a controlled way to evaluate both what graph agents conclude and whether their exploration reaches distinct evidential sources.

AI.tldr: GraphEcho 基准测试揭示 LLM 智能体在图上探索时会错误地将重复遍历的路径当作独立证据，混淆"探索效率"与"证据有效性"。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体能够在图上走过更多路径，但这些路径未必带来更多独立证据。重复遇到同一证据可能被智能体误认为是额外的佐证，从而影响其判断与探索行为。现有研究缺乏对"结论"与"探索是否触达独立证据源"两者的受控评估工具。
AI.method: 提出 GraphEcho 基准：在固定证据内容不变的前提下，改变路径数量与证据来源，评估智能体的判断与主动探索行为。同时在受控合成任务与科学论断任务上进行实验，并提出来源感知后训练（PAPT）方法以缓解重复问题。
AI.result: 受控合成实验显示，智能体判断变化依赖具体模型，但冗余支持路径在所有被评估的冻结智能体中都提高了重复遍历的占比。PAPT 能减少重访并提升合成任务准确率，但覆盖的来源更少；在科学论断任务上，它继续减少重复，但准确率反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究暴露了高效探索与有效证据利用之间的鸿沟：智能体可能学会停止重复自身，却忽视了真正需要的信息。GraphEcho 提供了一种受控方式，同时评估图智能体得出的结论及其探索是否触达独立证据源。

title: A Better-Than-$3$ Approximation Algorithm for Demand Matching via Knapsack Intersection LP and Contention Resolution
summary:
The demand matching problem generalizes both the knapsack problem and the $b$-matching problem. In this problem, each edge of a graph has a demand and a weight, and each vertex has a capacity. The goal is to find a maximum weight subset of edges such that, at each vertex, the total demand of the incident selected edges does not exceed the vertex capacity. Parekh [IPCO 2011] proved that, if each edge is individually feasible, the natural LP relaxation for demand matching has integrality gap at most $3$, yielding a $3$-approximation algorithm. This bound is tight for the natural LP relaxation, matching the lower bound of Shepherd and Vetta [Math. Oper. Res. 2007].
  We present a randomized $(3/2 + \sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) \approx (2.914 + \varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the demand matching problem for every $\varepsilon > 0$, giving the first approximation ratio strictly better than $3$. For bipartite graphs, we obtain a randomized $(2 + \varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for every $\varepsilon > 0$. Both algorithms run in time polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ and the input length. Our algorithms use a strengthened LP relaxation based on intersecting the integral knapsack polytopes associated with the vertices, together with a multiple-choice generalization. As a key ingredient, we prove the existence of a $(q, 1/(1+q))$-balanced contention resolution scheme for the integral knapsack polytope for every $q \in [0, 1]$, which may be of independent interest. The balance guarantee $1/(1+q)$ is tight in the worst case over all knapsack instances.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究需求匹配问题（推广了背包问题与b-匹配问题），首次给出优于3的近似比：一般图随机(3/2+√2+ε)≈2.914+ε近似算法，二部图随机(2+ε)近似算法。方法基于相交整数背包多面体加强的LP松弛，并证明存在(q,1/(1+q))-平衡的争用消解方案。
AI.motivation: 需求匹配问题中，若每条边单独可行，Parekh证明自然LP松弛的整性间隙至多3，得到3-近似算法，且该界对自然LP是紧的（Shepherd与Vetta的下界）。论文旨在打破3这一屏障，获得严格优于3的近似比。
AI.method: 采用基于在顶点处相交整数背包多面体的加强LP松弛，并结合多选（multiple-choice）推广；关键工具是为整数背包多面体构造(q,1/(1+q))-平衡的争用消解方案，对任意q∈[0,1]成立。算法运行时间为1/ε与输入长度的多项式。
AI.result: 一般图得到随机(3/2+√2+ε)≈2.914+ε近似算法；二部图得到随机(2+ε)近似算法，均为首次优于3的结果。同时证明背包多面体的平衡保证1/(1+q)在最坏情况下是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过加强LP松弛与平衡争用消解方案，将需求匹配的近似比从紧界3改进到约2.914（一般图）和2（二部图），且所用平衡争用消解方案可独立应用于其他问题。

title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents execute long-horizon tasks on dynamic graphical user interfaces, where pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets routinely invalidate plans fixed before execution. Recent agent-skill frameworks encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge to mitigate this, yet existing skill designs are largely developed without targeting GUI execution dynamics and treat skills as static artifacts produced before deployment rather than living procedural knowledge that improves through it. We argue that what GUI agents need is not better static skills, but skills that can be revised from execution feedback at deployment time, without additional training. We propose \textbf{EvoSkill-GUI}, a training-free framework in which each skill is a structured multi-file package containing retrieval metadata, executable plans, backup localization, failure-recovery rules, accessibility utilities, and failure cases. EvoSkill-GUI operates through a \textbf{\emph{reflect-revise-reuse}} loop: the executor performs instant in-rollout revisions, an isolated critic diagnoses failed trajectories under strict information isolation, and the executor edits specific skill files through a restricted tool interface. Across MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, and OSWorld, three mainstream GUI benchmarks spanning mobile and desktop platforms, EvoSkill-GUI consistently improves multiple base models without any training, with maximum gains of $+16.2\%$, $+6.0\%$, and $+10.5\%$ respectively, and evolved skill libraries continue to benefit related tasks rather than being rebuilt from scratch. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EvoSkill-GUI.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 EvoSkill-GUI，将技能视为可在部署期由执行反馈持续修正的"活"程序性知识，通过 reflect-revise-reuse 循环提升 GUI 智能体长程任务表现。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体需在动态界面（弹窗、延迟加载、控件位移）上执行长程任务，执行前固定的计划易失效。现有技能框架多面向静态产物，未针对 GUI 执行动态设计，也未将技能视为可在部署期改进的知识。
AI.method: 免训练框架。每个技能为结构化多文件包，含检索元数据、可执行计划、备用定位、失败恢复规则、无障碍工具与失败案例。运行 reflect-revise-reuse 循环：执行器在 rollout 内即时修订；隔离的 critic 在严格信息隔离下诊断失败轨迹；执行器经受限工具接口编辑特定技能文件。
AI.result: 在 MobileWorld、AndroidWorld、OSWorld 三个移动与桌面 GUI 基准上，无需训练即稳定提升多个基座模型，最大增益分别为 +16.2%、+6.0%、+10.5%；演化后的技能库可迁移受益于相关任务，而非每次重建。
AI.conclusion: GUI 智能体所需并非更优的静态技能，而是可在部署期从执行反馈修订且无需额外训练的技能；EvoSkill-GUI 验证了该"活"技能范式的有效性与可复用性。

title: REVERSAL-BENCH: A Reversibility Axis and Reset Oracle for Measuring the Reset-Free RL Cliff
summary: A central goal of autonomous reinforcement learning is continuous policy training without external resets. However, existing paradigms largely depend on underlying environmental reversibility, a property absent in real world manipulation, where events such as pushing objects off tables or spilling granular substances cannot be undone. We introduce REVERSAL-BENCH, a benchmark that controls reversibility via a continuous parameter $ρ\in [0, 1]$ and provides a reset oracle, a ground-truth verification mechanism to test state recoverability across eight manipulation settings in five physics engines. Evaluating a broad spectrum of policy architectures, including standard actor-critic algorithms, safe RL, and specialized reset-free frameworks, reveals a sharp reversibility cliff: reset-free agents are consistently absorbed into irrecoverable states as $ρ$ increases, whereas episodic agents maintain steady learning. We see this failure mode across autonomous reset-free baselines and constrained RL. Because reset-free agents lack external resets, any transition into an irrecoverable state results in permanent absorption, leaving the agent trapped where further learning halts. We show that this absorption phenomenon persists in full physics simulations under learned manipulation policies. By evaluating against geometrically identical reversible counterparts, we confirm that this breakdown is causally driven by irreversibility rather than obstacle complexity. We release the benchmark suite, a large multi-simulator dataset labeled with recoverability and a reset oracle. We also evaluate a safety shield that intervenes before irreversible failures occur, showing that while recoverability can be predicted accurately, active recovery primarily succeeds only when the agent can physically steer clear of the trap

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REVERSAL-BENCH 基准，通过连续可逆性参数 ρ 与重置预言机系统研究自主强化学习在不可逆操作任务中的失效现象，揭示了"可逆性悬崖"：免重置智能体随 ρ 增大被永久吸收进不可恢复状态，而情节式智能体保持稳定学习。
AI.motivation: 自主强化学习的核心目标是无需外部重置即可持续训练策略，但现有范式普遍依赖环境的可逆性。真实世界操作任务中存在大量不可逆事件（如将物体推下桌子、洒出颗粒物质），这类事件无法撤销。作者希望系统性地量化不可逆性对免重置学习的影响，并检验策略架构在该条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建 REVERSAL-BENCH 基准：用连续参数 ρ∈[0,1] 控制环境可逆程度，并提供重置预言机（reset oracle）作为验证状态可恢复性的真值机制；覆盖五大物理引擎、八种操作场景。评估多种策略架构，包括标准 actor-critic、安全强化学习及专门的免重置框架；并通过与几何结构完全相同但可逆的对照环境进行因果对比。此外评估一种在不可逆失败发生前介入的安全防护罩（safety shield）。
AI.result: 随 ρ 增大出现明显的"可逆性悬崖"：免重置智能体被一致地吸收进不可恢复状态，而情节式智能体学习保持稳定；该失效模式在免重置基线与约束强化学习中均出现。由于缺乏外部重置，任何进入不可恢复状态的转移都会导致永久吸收，学习随即停止。该吸收现象在真实物理仿真与学到的操作策略下依然存在。几何相同但可逆的对照实验确认，该崩溃由不可逆性而非障碍复杂度因果导致。安全防护罩结果表明：可恢复性可被准确预测，但主动恢复仅在智能体能物理避开陷阱时才主要成功。
AI.conclusion: 不可逆性是免重置自主强化学习的根本性瓶颈，单纯依靠可恢复性预测不足以解决问题，主动恢复受限于智能体的物理可达性。作者公开了基准套件、带可恢复性标注的多仿真器大规模数据集以及重置预言机，为后续研究提供平台。

title: TuiML: Machine Learning for AI Agents
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Code and documentation at https://tuiml.ai
summary: Machine-learning libraries such as Weka and scikit-learn were designed for human programmers. Language-model agents now use these same libraries by recalling APIs from memory and writing code, an approach that hides what a library offers, delays errors until runtime, and loses experimental state between turns. We present TuiML, a self-contained machine-learning library built for AI agents, with native algorithms across supervised, unsupervised, time-series, data handling, tuning, and evaluation tasks. Every component describes itself through machine-readable metadata and parameter schemas, so an agent can search the library, inspect components, compose validated workflows, and register new ones that become discoverable in turn. Every call is validated, seeded, and traced, and sessions export as runnable notebooks, making experiments reproducible by construction. One specification layer drives the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-framework adapters, a Python API, a CLI, and local model serving, while data and models never leave the machine. Benchmarks show TuiML remains predictively competitive with scikit-learn and Weka. While looking like a conventional library to a human user, TuiML is designed for agents first, allowing them to read, extend, and operate machine learning autonomously. TuiML is open source, with documentation at https://tuiml.ai.

AI.tldr: TuiML 是一个面向 AI 智能体设计的自包含机器学习库，通过机器可读元数据、参数模式、调用验证与追踪，让智能体可自主检索、组合、扩展和复现机器学习工作流。

AI.method: 提出 TuiML：包含覆盖监督学习、无监督学习、时间序列、数据处理、调参与评估的原生算法；每个组件通过机器可读元数据与参数模式自描述，支持智能体检索组件、查看组件、组合经校验的工作流并注册可被发现的新组件；每次调用均经校验、设置随机种子并被追踪，会话可导出为可运行 notebook；由单一规范层驱动 MCP、智能体框架适配器、Python API、CLI 与本地模型服务，数据与模型不出本机。
AI.result: 基准测试表明 TuiML 的预测性能与 scikit-learn 和 Weka 相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TuiML 对人类用户看似常规库，但以智能体优先为设计理念，使智能体能够自主读取、扩展和操作机器学习。TuiML 已开源，文档见 https://tuiml.ai。

title: Adaptive hybrid coupling with operator inference, the overlapping Schwarz alternating method and reinforcement learning
summary: Hybrid domain decomposition methods provide a flexible framework for coupling full order models (FOMs) and reduced order models (ROMs), but typically assume the model assigned to each subdomain is fixed throughout a simulation. This is limiting for transient problems in which localized features propagate through the domain and the regions requiring high-fidelity resolution change over time. We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL)-based approach for online adaptation of FOM-ROM models coupled via the overlapping Schwarz alternating method (O-SAM), an iterative domain decomposition method that solves subdomain-local problems while exchanging solution information through transmission boundary conditions on overlapping interfaces. Deep Q-networks (DQNs) are trained offline to select among subdomain-local FOMs and pre-trained Operator Inference (OpInf) ROMs using a reward balancing accuracy, cost, and model-switching frequency. Once trained, the policies are deployed predictively on problem instances not seen during training, without requiring a reference FOM solution. We demonstrate the approach on two examples: a 1D advection-diffusion problem with a moving front, and a 3D linear elastic wave propagation problem implemented in the Norma.jl solid mechanics code. For the advection-diffusion benchmark, the learned policy dynamically allocates high-fidelity resolution as the front propagates and outperforms static FOM/ROM assignments; letting the agent also adapt the domain decomposition provides no further benefit. For the elastic wave benchmark, learned policies for two and three subdomain decompositions track the propagating wave by assigning FOMs to subdomains containing the wave and ROMs elsewhere, as expected. Our results demonstrate the potential of RL to enable predictive online adaptation of model fidelity within Schwarz-based hybrid simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于强化学习（DQN）的在线自适应框架，用于重叠Schwarz交替法（O-SAM）耦合的FOM-ROM混合域分解模拟，实现随局部特征传播动态调整各子域模型保真度。
AI.motivation: 混合域分解方法虽能灵活耦合FOM与ROM，但通常假设各子域模型在整个模拟过程中固定不变。这对局部特征在域内传播、需要高保真分辨率的区域随时间变化的瞬态问题构成限制，因此需要在线自适应模型保真度的方法。
AI.method: 将子域局部FOM与预训练Operator Inference（OpInf）ROM的选择建模为序贯决策问题，采用深度Q网络（DQN）离线训练策略，奖励函数平衡精度、成本与模型切换频率；训练后的策略在未见的测试问题上预测性部署，且无需参考FOM解；在O-SAM迭代框架下通过重叠界面传输边界条件交换解信息。算例包括带移动前沿的1D对流-扩散问题和基于Norma.jl固体力学代码的3D线弹性波传播问题。
AI.result: 对流-扩散算例中，学习策略随前沿传播动态分配高保真分辨率，优于静态FOM/ROM分配；同时让智能体自适应域分解未带来额外收益。弹性波算例中，两子域与三子域分解的学习策略均能跟踪传播波，将FOM分配给含波子域、其余区域使用ROM，符合预期。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明强化学习具备在基于Schwarz的混合模拟中实现在线自适应模型保真度的潜力，可支持无需参考解的预测性部署。

title: A Walk From Free Probability to Matrix Discrepancy I: Matrix Spencer
comment: The authors explicitly reserve all rights in this work. No permission is granted for the reproduction, storage, or use of this document for the purpose of training artificial intelligence systems or for text and data mining (TDM), including but not limited to the generation of embeddings, summaries, or synthetic derivatives
summary:
The Matrix Spencer conjecture asks whether any $n$ real symmetric matrices A_1,...,A_n \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times m} of operator norm at most one admit a signing $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ such that the operator norm of the signed sum is at most O(\sqrt{n \log(2m/n)}) We give a randomized algorithm establishing this bound with polynomial runtime in the real-arithmetic model. We first prove the $O(\sqrt n)$ bound for $m\le n$, resolving the square case, and then obtain the rectangular bound by changing the regularizer. As in earlier algorithmic discrepancy methods \cite{lovettmeka2012,bansalLaddhaVempala2022,pesentivladu2026}, we run a covariance-controlled random walk from the origin of the hypercube, rounding coordinates near its faces and keeping them fixed. Our potential measures a soft spectral edge of the evolving discrepancy matrix perturbed by an operator-valued free semicircular element. Inspired by the free interpolation approach of \cite{bbvh2023}, we combine Lehner's variational formula for the free edge \cite{lehner1999} with spectral Tsallis regularization \cite{allenZhuLiaoOrecchia2015,pesentivladu2026}. This puts the discrepancy and remaining covariance in a single smooth optimization problem. The potential has a finite-dimensional semidefinite formulation. Stability of its optimizer, governed by equations related to the matrix Dyson equation \cite{erdos2019}, lets us find a large subspace in which to move while controlling discrepancy. The square case uses the Tsallis--$1/2$ regularizer; the rectangular case uses a suitable generalized Tsallis power regularizer.
  Our companion paper \cite{kathuria2026ks} applies these ideas to give an algorithmic proof of Weaver's discrepancy theorem, whose existence proof by [MSS15] resolved the Kadison--Singer conjecture \cite{mss2015}.Lean formalizations of our main discrepancy theorems have been completed and will be released shortly.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明矩阵Spencer猜想：对算子范数不超过1的实对称矩阵组，存在签名使符号和的算子范数不超过O(√(n log(2m/n)))，并给出多项式时间的随机算法，同时在实数算术模型中处理方形与矩形情形。
AI.motivation: 矩阵Spencer猜想是差异理论中的核心问题，此前仅有非算法性存在性结果，缺乏高效构造性证明。本文旨在给出该界的随机多项式时间算法，并从方形推广到矩形矩阵情形。
AI.method: 采用协方差控制的超立方体随机游走，从原点出发，逐步对接近面的坐标进行舍入并固定。势函数刻画演化差异矩阵被算子值自由半圆元扰动后的软谱边缘，结合Lehner自由边缘变分公式与谱Tsallis正则化，将差异与剩余协方差统一为光滑优化问题，并具有有限维半正定表述；其优化器的稳定性由与矩阵Dyson方程相关的方程控制，从而找到可移动的大子空间。方形情形用Tsallis-1/2正则化，矩形情形用广义Tsallis幂正则化。
AI.result: 证明了m≤n时的O(√n)界，解决了方形情形；通过更换正则化器得到矩形界，即达到O(√(n log(2m/n)))的算子范数上界，算法在实数算术模型下具有多项式运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为矩阵Spencer猜想提供了算法性证明，建立了自由概率与差异理论方法之间的联系，其伴生论文将该思想用于Weaver差异定理的算法证明；主要差异定理的Lean形式化已完成并将发布。

title: PrimeScientist: Strategic Allocation of Research Effort in Autonomous Research
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Henri-XYu02/PrimeScientist
summary: Autonomous research agents aim to automate scientific workflows, from proposing ideas to conducting experiments and analyzing results. Yet current AI and research agents can propose more directions than available resources allow them to pursue. Moreover, each attempt could consume substantial resources, requiring agents to reconsider how to invest in subsequent research. Thus, deciding how to invest research effort strategically should be a defining capability of autonomous research agents. Accordingly, we introduce PrimeScientist, which jointly determines research direction and resource investment across successive research attempts. Specifically, we formulate this challenge of strategic research effort allocation as a sequential decision problem where remaining resources should explicitly guide the research policy. We first introduce an executable plan tree that preserves competing plans and their outcomes across attempts. Building on this representation, we propose an adaptive MCTS-based allocation policy that balances exploration and exploitation using experimental feedback and remaining resources. Comprehensive evaluations across AI research, systems and code optimization, and machine learning engineering show that strategic allocation improves research quality and sample efficiency together. Across 12 AI research tasks, PrimeScientist improves average reward by 10.3% with 50.6% fewer research attempts than AutoResearch under the same resource budget. We believe making research effort allocation an explicit optimization target establishes effective resource use as a core research capability for autonomous agents to drive scientific breakthroughs at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PrimeScientist，将自主研究代理的“研究方向选择”与“资源投入分配”联合建模为序贯决策问题，利用可执行计划树与自适应 MCTS 策略在有限资源下权衡探索与利用。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI 与研究代理能提出的研究方向远超可用资源，且每次尝试成本高昂，因此“如何战略性地分配研究投入”应成为自主研究代理的核心能力。现有工作多关注提出方向或执行实验，却缺乏对资源约束下策略性投入的显式优化。
AI.method: 将战略性研究投入分配形式化为序贯决策问题，并让剩余资源显式引导研究策略。为此引入可执行计划树（executable plan tree），在多次尝试中保留相互竞争的计划及其结果；基于该表示提出自适应 MCTS 分配策略，利用实验反馈与剩余资源平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在 AI 研究、系统与代码优化、机器学习工程等场景评测中，战略性分配同时提升研究质量与样本效率。在 12 个 AI 研究任务上，相同资源预算下，PrimeScientist 相比 AutoResearch 平均奖励提升 10.3%，研究尝试次数减少 50.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将研究投入分配显式作为优化目标，可使高效资源利用成为自主代理的核心研究能力，从而支撑规模化科学突破。

title: Secretary Problems with Interactive Ordinal Queries
summary:
We study secretary problems in which the online algorithm can ask a reliable oracle a limited number of ordinal queries about unseen elements. Values are revealed only when elements arrive, and all accept/reject decisions are irrevocable. The oracle never reveals numerical values; it only answers questions defined relative to the information already observed by the algorithm.
  We first consider the single-choice secretary problem. A query returns the number of unseen elements whose value exceeds the current record. We analyze random order, adversarial order, and two sample-based adversarial orders, with no queries, one query, and unlimited queries. We obtain tight bounds for all variants except one. In adversarial order, queries do not improve over the trivial $1/n$ guarantee. In random order, one query improves the optimal success probability from $1/e$ to $0.4477\ldots$, and unlimited queries achieve the optimal value $1/2$. In the sample-based models, one query already yields the tight value $1/e$ against an online adversary, while unlimited queries give the exact value $(20\sqrt{10}-29)/81$ against an offline adversary. The remaining one-query offline-adversarial case is left open, and we give two partial upper bounds for it.
  We also extend the model to the matroid secretary problem, where we study two ordinal query interfaces. A simple query identifies the unseen elements that would individually improve the current optimum on the observed set, while a complete query gives a finer ordinal partition of the unseen elements by weight relative to that optimum. Under sample-based online adversarial order, a single simple query yields a $1/4$ probability-competitive algorithm, and a complete query improves this to the optimal $1/e$. Finally, with unlimited complete queries in the random-order model, we achieve the optimal $1/2$ probability-competitive ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有限序数查询预言机的秘书问题，在单选择秘书问题中针对随机序、对抗序及两种基于样本的对抗序，分别无查询、一次查询和无限查询情形给出紧界；并将模型推广至拟阵秘书问题，通过简单查询与完全查询两种接口得到概率竞争比结果。
AI.motivation: 经典秘书问题中算法只能观测到达元素的相对序，决策不可撤销，成功率受信息限制。作者希望探索：若允许在线算法向可靠预言机提出有限次序数查询（不揭示数值，仅回答相对于已观测信息的问题），能否提升成功率，并在不同到达顺序模型下刻画查询能力与最优竞争比之间的关系。
AI.method: 将预言机查询定义为序数型：单选择情形中一次查询返回超过当前记录的未见元素数量；分析随机序、对抗序和两种基于样本的对抗序，在零次、一次和无限次查询下的最优成功概率。进一步将模型扩展到拟阵秘书问题，设计两种查询接口：简单查询识别可单独改进当前最优解的未见元素，完全查询给出未见元素相对于当前最优权的更精细序数划分；在基于样本的在线对抗序与随机序下分析概率竞争算法。
AI.result: 单选择秘书问题中除一个变体外均获紧界：对抗序下查询不优于平凡的1/n保证；随机序下一次查询将最优成功概率从1/e提升至0.4477…，无限查询达到最优1/2；基于样本模型中，在线对抗序下一次查询已达紧值1/e，离线对抗序下无限查询给出精确值(20√10−29)/81，剩余一次查询离线对抗情形开放，并给出两个部分上界。拟阵秘书问题中，基于样本在线对抗序下单次简单查询得到1/4概率竞争算法，完全查询提升至最优1/e；随机序下无限完全查询达到最优1/2概率竞争比。
AI.conclusion: 有限序数查询能显著增强在线秘书算法的能力，但其增益高度依赖到达顺序模型与查询接口：对抗序下收益有限，随机序与样本模型下可逼近甚至达到最优竞争比。拟阵推广表明更丰富的序数划分可将竞争比从1/4提升至1/e乃至1/2。一个单选择离线对抗一次查询问题仍未解决。

title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe actions one call at a time, and no single deterministic artifact supports both roles. We present ContrAgent, a contract-based framework for symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents. ContrAgent captures an agent's behavior as a sequence of tool calls and formalizes it as a trace over a fixed set of checkable predicates. It then specifies required behaviors using assume-guarantee contracts in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTLf). Each contract is compiled to a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) that serves two roles: gating agent actions online and evaluating recorded traces offline. A contract library, acting as a reusable knowledge base, is maintained independently of the agent's model and can be applied across different agents within the same task domain. We show the effectiveness of our approach on four benchmarks spanning both roles, where ContrAgent matches state-of-the-art LLM-judge and rule-based guardrail baselines while producing deterministic, reproducible verdicts and, in the online mode, orders-of-magnitude lower per-call latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContrAgent，一种基于契约的符号时序监督框架，用 LTLf 契约编译为确定性有限自动机（DFA），统一实现在线门控与离线轨迹评估，具备确定性、可复现与低延迟特性。
AI.motivation: LLM 工具智能体可自动化多步复杂任务，但存在幻觉、分布不稳定、对抗操纵等问题，且部分工具调用后果不可逆。现有防护手段要么用随机 LLM 评判器事后打分轨迹，要么逐次调用阻断不安全动作，缺乏单一确定性产物同时支撑这两种角色。

title: WFM: Wiki Foundation Model for Complex Agentic Reasoning
summary: Real-world agents fundamentally require persistent non-parametric knowledge for dynamic reasoning, i.e., long-term memory and retrieval-augmented generation. While graphs have shown reliable advantages in providing structured evidence, the sparse graph representations naturally restrict machine readability and semantic density required for complex agentic workflows. Driven by this limitation, the entire industry is witnessing a paradigm shift from traditional sparse graphs to LLM Wiki, an agent-native knowledge representation that couples dense document contexts with markdown files containing multi-layered topological linkages. However, parameterizing such rich semantics is challenging to encode dense textual contexts using traditional sparse graph embeddings. Moreover, learning LLM Wiki with existing graph encoders could overwhelm distributed system overheads that hinder deployment in large-scale commercial scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel paradigm Wiki Foundation Model, i.e., WFM, tailored for scalable, agent-native representation and retrieval. Specifically, (i) we formalize a Wiki Graph schema that seamlessly bridges fine-grained structures with dense contexts, maintaining explicit topologies alongside continuous semantics; (ii) A query-conditioned attentive aggregation is tailored for rich wiki message passing and explicit attention variance regularization; (iii) We engineer an infrastructural NCCL boundary exchange protocol that hoists static partition indices and leverages fixed-shape GPU-to-GPU collectives, bypassing CPU serialization and memory copy overheads. Extensive evaluations across five long-term agent memory and multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the remarkable performance of WFM, while achieving a 10.5 times training acceleration on distributed clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向智能体的知识表示新范式 Wiki Foundation Model（WFM），通过融合稠密文档上下文与稠密拓扑链接的 Wiki Graph、查询条件化注意力聚合及 NCCL 边界交换协议，实现可扩展的智能体原生表示与检索，在五个长时记忆与多跳推理基准上取得显著性能，并在分布式集群上实现 10.5 倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: 真实场景智能体需要持久化的非参数化知识支撑动态推理（长期记忆与检索增强生成）。图结构虽能提供可靠的结构化证据，但稀疏图表示限制了机器可读性与语义密度，难以满足复杂智能体工作流需求。产业界正从传统稀疏图转向 LLM Wiki（耦合稠密文档上下文与含多层拓扑链接的 markdown 文件）。然而，用传统稀疏图嵌入编码稠密文本上下文困难，且现有图编码器学习 LLM Wiki 会带来分布式系统开销，阻碍大规模商业部署。
AI.method: (i) 形式化 Wiki Graph schema，将细粒度结构与稠密上下文无缝衔接，在保留显式拓扑的同时维持连续语义；(ii) 设计查询条件化注意力聚合（query-conditioned attentive aggregation），用于丰富的 wiki 消息传递，并引入显式注意力方差正则化；(iii) 构建基础设施层面的 NCCL 边界交换协议，将静态分区索引上提并采用固定形状的 GPU-to-GPU 集合通信，规避 CPU 序列化与内存拷贝开销。
AI.result: 在五个长期智能体记忆与多跳推理基准上进行了广泛评估，WFM 展现出显著性能，并在分布式集群上实现 10.5 倍训练加速。
AI.conclusion: WFM 作为面向可扩展、智能体原生表示与检索的新范式，有效弥合了稀疏图与稠密语义之间的鸿沟，兼顾性能与分布式训练效率，为大规模商业场景下的智能体知识表示与检索提供了可行方案。

title: Maximum Strong Independent Sets in Hypergraphs: Reductions, Bounds, and Greedy Certificates
summary: We study the maximum strong independent set problem in a finite hypergraph: find the largest vertex set that intersects every hyperedge in at most one vertex. This objective arises whenever each observed block is a local incompatibility constraint but transitive closure across overlapping blocks is not justified. A motivating example is multi-band LSH-MinHash deduplication, where each collision bucket gives local evidence, while connected-component contraction can impose spurious global equivalences. The paper develops an incidence-structural toolkit for this problem. We prove exact reductions for dominance, incidence twins, and weight-1 blocks; derive closed-form and low-weight upper bounds; introduce puncturing and covering certificates that sharpen those bounds; and analyze a layered greedy clustering algorithm driven by block weights and residual incidence. The algorithmic analysis includes feasibility, maximality, conditional optimality, a layered witness-matching upper bound, and incidence-local complexity bounds. The results give correctness, termination, fixed-point, and optimality certificates for broad incidence families, together with examples showing when different certificates separate or coincide.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限超图中的最大强独立集问题（即寻找与每条超边至多相交一个顶点的最大顶点集），建立关联结构工具包，给出精确归约、上界与证书，并分析分层贪心聚类算法。
AI.motivation: 该目标源于每个观测块构成局部不相容约束、但跨重叠块的传递闭包不成立的场景。典型动机是多频段LSH-MinHash去重：每个碰撞桶提供局部证据，而连通分量收缩会引入虚假的全局等价关系，因此需要更强独立集而非连通分量收缩。
AI.method: 发展关联结构工具包：证明支配、关联孪生与权重为1块的精确归约；推导闭式与低权重上界；引入穿刺证书与覆盖证书以收紧上界；分析由块权重和剩余关联驱动的分层贪心聚类算法，并给出可行性、极大性、条件最优性、分层见证匹配上界及关联局部复杂度界。
AI.result: 获得适用于广泛关联族的正确性、终止性、不动点与最优性证书，并通过示例展示不同证书何时相互区分或重合。
AI.conclusion: 本文为最大强独立集问题提供了系统的关联结构分析框架与证书体系，兼顾精确归约、上界刻画与算法分析，可用于超图去重等局部约束场景。

title: Where Should Agents Live? Energy-Memory Characterization of Agentic AI for the Edge-Cloud Continuum
summary: As telecommunication networks evolve toward autonomous 5G-Advanced and 6G operations, agentic artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, where large language models (LLMs) execute multi-step reasoning, invoke diagnostic tools, retrieve domain knowledge, and coordinate across agent teams, are increasingly embedded across the edge-cloud continuum. While the biological brain accomplishes complex cognition on an exceptionally modest metabolic power budget of approximately 20W contemporary LLMs are profoundly energy- and memory-intensive, making sustainable lifecycle orchestration a critical operational priority. However, existing AI lifecycle metrics evaluate only isolated, single-model inferences or overlook multi-agent execution graphs entirely. Consequently, network operators lack foundational models to determine whether distributed agent communication incurs meaningful energy costs and where across edge-cloud tiers agent teams should physically reside. To address this gap, we introduce agentic-eCAL, generalizing the Energy Cost of AI Lifecycle (eCAL) metric to directed multi-agent workflows by coupling a closed-form two-rate single-call energy model (compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode) with 7-layer OSI data transport. Grounded in hundreds of GPU benchmark configurations on NVIDIA A100 and H100, 16 open-weight models and 8 orchestration topologies, we validate components of the metric and study workflow placement implications. Our findings demonstrate that inter-agent text transport incurs 0.25% of workflow energy across 5G RAN, metro, and optical links. Therefore in edge-cloud agent placement the dominant energy cost of distribution is often not the transmission of inter-agent text itself, but the additional inference and context processing induced by that communication.

AI.tldr: 提出agentic-eCAL指标，将AI生命周期能耗度量从单模型推理推广到多智能体工作流，耦合闭式双速率单次调用能耗模型与7层OSI数据传输，并在A100/H100实测验证，发现智能体间文本传输仅占工作流能耗0.25%，分布部署的主导能耗来自通信引发的额外推理与上下文处理。
AI.motivation: 电信网络向自主5G-Advanced/6G演进，基于LLM的智能体AI工作流广泛部署于边云连续体，其能耗与内存开销远高于生物大脑约20W的代谢预算，可持续生命周期编排成为关键运营需求。然而现有AI生命周期指标仅评估孤立的单模型推理或忽略多智能体执行图，网络运营商缺乏基础模型判断分布式智能体通信是否带来显著能耗、以及智能体团队应物理驻留在边云哪一层级。
AI.method: 提出agentic-eCAL，将有向多智能体工作流的能耗成本指标（eCAL）一般化：耦合闭式双速率单次调用能耗模型（计算受限的prefill与内存受限的decode）与7层OSI数据传输模型。基于NVIDIA A100与H100上数百种GPU基准配置、16个开放权重模型和8种编排拓扑进行指标组件的验证，并研究工作流放置的影响。
AI.result: 跨5G RAN、城域与光链路场景下，智能体间文本传输仅占工作流能耗的0.25%；因此在边云智能体放置中，分布式部署的主导能耗往往不是智能体间文本传输本身，而是该通信所引发的额外推理与上下文处理开销。
AI.conclusion: agentic-eCAL为多智能体AI工作流提供了可量化的生命周期能耗建模范式，弥补了现有指标对多智能体执行图建模的缺失，为网络运营商在边云连续体中进行智能体团队放置与可持续编排提供了依据：优化重点应放在通信引发的推理与上下文处理，而非链路传输能耗本身。

title: What Counts as Strategic Reasoning? A Systematic Mapping of Chess Research on Humans, Engines, and Language Models
comment: Under review; replication package available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22695754
summary:
Chess has long served as a model domain for studying search, expertise, decision-making, and artificial intelligence. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has renewed the relevance of chess as a controlled environment for investigating strategic reasoning and comparing human and artificial decision-making. We present a systematic mapping study of recent research spanning human players, classical chess engines, neural and reinforcement-learning systems, LLMs, and hybrid approaches. The final map comprises 84 core study families, classified according to agent type, strategic-reasoning stages, and evaluation dimensions.
  The map reveals a literature strongly concentrated on situation assessment, evaluation, and action selection, while explicit planning, explanation, metacognition, and human--AI collaboration remain less explored. LLM research places particular emphasis on state representation and generalization, whereas grounded explanation appears more frequently in hybrid approaches combining language models with engines, expert knowledge, or other external structures. Two distinctions emerge that the map aggregates rather than resolves: hybrid systems differ in where and when heterogeneous capabilities combine, and evaluations that show improved human performance do not thereby establish human--AI synergy. We propose both as extensions of the mapping framework.
  We argue that chess provides a useful bridge between cognitive and computational perspectives on strategic reasoning, and identify explicit planning, grounded and faithful explanation, metacognitive calibration, and human--AI complementarity as directions for future research.

AI.method: 采用系统性映射研究（systematic mapping study），覆盖人类棋手、经典棋类引擎、神经与强化学习系统、大语言模型及混合方法等研究；将文献归纳为84个核心研究族，并按智能体类型、战略推理阶段和评估维度进行分类。

title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time. Existing methods either correct the context without repairing altered environment states or restore earlier states while discarding useful experience, making it difficult to both eliminate failure conditions and avoid repeating past mistakes. We argue that reliable recovery should instead be treated as a rollback-boundary control problem that jointly determines when to intervene, where to resume, and what information should survive recovery. Based on this view, we propose Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR), a unified recovery framework that restores execution to a selected prior state while carrying forward reusable knowledge distilled from the abandoned trajectory to guide subsequent decisions. We further characterize recovery through a unified operator over rollback depth and retained memory, providing a general view of state restoration and knowledge retention. Experiments on three long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate that RIR consistently improves task performance across multiple LLM backbones, with structured reflection memory preserving useful experience and selective rollback enabling efficient recovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR) 统一恢复框架，将长时域 LLM 智能体的可靠恢复建模为"回滚边界控制"问题，在回滚到历史状态的同时保留可复用知识，实现状态修复与经验保留的双重目标，并在三个长时域基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在多步环境交互中，单次错误动作会改变后续状态与观测，导致误差随时间累积放大。现有方法存在两难：一类只修正上下文而不修复已被改变的环境状态；另一类虽能恢复早期状态却丢弃了已有经验，从而难以同时消除失败条件与避免重蹈覆辙。因此需要一种能联合决定"何时干预、从何处续接、哪些信息应在恢复后存留"的恢复机制。
AI.method: 将可靠恢复形式化为回滚边界控制问题，提出 Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR) 统一恢复框架：把执行恢复到选定的历史状态（selective rollback），同时从被放弃的轨迹中蒸馏可复用知识（structured reflection memory）并前向携带以指导后续决策。此外，用一个统一算子刻画回滚深度与保留记忆两个维度，给出状态恢复与知识保留的一般化视角。
AI.result: 在三个长时域基准上，RIR 在多种 LLM 主干模型上均稳定提升任务表现；其中结构化反思记忆有效保留了有用经验，选择性回滚则实现了高效恢复。
AI.conclusion: 可靠恢复应被视作状态修复与经验保留的联合控制问题，而非单一的上下文纠错或状态重置。RIR 通过回滚边界控制将二者统一，为长时域智能体的错误恢复提供了通用且有效的范式。

title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery
summary: How does a multi-agent system evolve from a local deviation into collective loss of control? We propose an epidemic explanation organized around accidental mutation, contagion, and recovery. A spontaneous deviation creates a seed; communication enables other agents to adopt and retransmit its unsafe strategy; collective failure can emerge when propagation outpaces correction and containment. Thus, rare individual deviations can coexist with substantial collective risk. Motivated by reported OpenAI agent coordination incidents, we examine two ingredients of this mechanism. A deployment audit identifies implicit communication paths between nominally independent evaluation runs and verifies transport through a default Docker backend. RogueHandoff-20, a benchmark of 20 executable scenarios, tests recipient susceptibility by injecting unsafe trajectories generated by a modified Qwen-27B route. Across four native-pending routes, executed harm is 0-5% on normal tasks and 40-95% after injection, exceeding paired direct malicious requests by 5-45 percentage points. These results support low observed baseline harm alongside high conditional susceptibility; they do not establish natural rare-event rates or demonstrate an autonomous cascade. The account motivates complementary defenses: strengthen resistance and recovery alongside prevention of spontaneous deviations, and audit and restrict unintended communication paths that can turn local failures into collective loss of control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"流行病学"框架（意外突变—传染—恢复）解释多智能体系统如何从局部偏差演化为集体失控，并通过部署审计与RogueHandoff-20基准验证了隐式通信路径的存在及智能体对不安全轨迹的高条件易感性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，罕见个体偏差为何能与显著的集体风险并存，其从局部偏离演化为集体失控的机制尚不清晰。作者受已报道的OpenAI智能体协调事件启发，试图给出一个统一的机制性解释。
AI.method: 提出由意外变异、传染与恢复三要素构成的流行病学解释：自发偏差形成"种子"，通信使其他智能体采纳并再传播不安全策略，当传播速度超过纠正与遏制时出现集体失效。实证上包含两部分：(1) 部署审计，识别名义上独立的评估运行之间的隐式通信路径，并通过默认Docker后端验证其传输；(2) RogueHandoff-20基准，含20个可执行场景，通过注入由改进的Qwen-27B路线生成的不安全轨迹来测试接收方易感性。
AI.result: 在四条原生待定（native-pending）路线上，正常任务的实际危害率为0–5%，注入后升至40–95%，比配对的直接恶意请求高出5–45个百分点。结果支持"低观测基线危害伴随高条件易感性"的判断，但未确立自然稀有事件发生率，也未证明存在自主级联。

title: APGEM: Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation for Quantum Reinforcement Learning on a Real-World CVRP Case Study
comment: Accepted at The 6th International Multi-Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (MCAIT2026)
summary: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) represents policies as variational quantum circuits (VQCs), making it attractive for combinatorial optimization such as the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP). On noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, however, decoherence degrades fidelity and destabilizes learning, and conventional error mitigation is applied statically without regard to the learning context. We introduce Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM), a controller that selects among Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) online, driven by a fidelity, entropy, and cost aware utility function and an epsilon-greedy rule over temporal-difference Q-scores. We evaluate on a realistic urban-logistics testbed, a Delhi-based CVRP over real landmarks with geodesic inter-node costs, exercised across five noise families and four severity levels. On this instance, the QRL agent outperforms constructive heuristics and approaches metaheuristics, while mitigation restores approximation ratios from 0.84-0.87 to 0.92-0.94 under high noise. The controller shifts from a CDR-dominated regime under short training horizons to a balanced deployment across all four techniques under longer horizons, indicating genuine regime-dependent selection. These preliminary results position adaptive, learning-aware mitigation as a practical route to noise-resilient QRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应策略引导纠错方法APGEM，在量子强化学习求解CVRP时，依据保真度、熵与代价感知的效用函数，通过epsilon-greedy策略在线动态选择ZNE、PEC、CDR与REM四种纠错技术，在高噪声下将近似比从0.84-0.87恢复至0.92-0.94。
AI.motivation: 量子强化学习（QRL）将策略表示为变分量子电路，适用于CVRP等组合优化问题。但在NISQ硬件上，退相干会降低保真度并使学习不稳定，而传统纠错技术是静态应用的，未考虑学习上下文，缺乏对噪声环境与训练阶段的适应性。
AI.method: 提出APGEM（自适应策略引导纠错）控制器：构建融合保真度、熵与代价的效用函数，并基于时序差分Q分数的epsilon-greedy规则，在ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM四种纠错技术之间进行在线选择。在基于德里真实地标、以测地距离为节点间代价的城市物流CVRP测试平台上评估，覆盖五类噪声族与四个噪声严重度等级。
AI.result: 在该CVRP实例上，QRL智能体优于构造式启发式算法并接近元启发式算法；在强噪声下，纠错使近似比从0.84-0.87恢复至0.92-0.94。控制器在短训练周期下偏向CDR主导机制，在较长周期下则均衡使用全部四种技术，表现出真实的机制依赖型选择行为。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、感知学习的纠错方法可作为实现抗噪QRL的实用路径。当前结果属于初步验证，表明动态纠错选择能有效提升NISQ环境下量子强化学习的稳定性与性能。

title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often suffer from capability stagnation in self-improvement training because fixed difficulty levels fail to adapt to their evolving proficiency. To address this issue, we propose STRETCH (Self-Taught Reasoning Evolution via Targeted CHallenge), a unified framework inspired by cognitive scaffolding theory. STRETCH introduces a dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism that continuously aligns question difficulty with the model's solving capability. Within a single parameter space, the model alternates between a Scaffolder that generates adaptive, boundary-pushing challenges and a Learner that that optimizes its solving trajectories through reinforcement learning. This dual-loop co-evolution effectively stabilizes training, mitigates reward hacking and promote progressive reasoning growth. Experiments on both negotiation and operation research benchmarks demonstrate that STRETCH consistently outperforms strong prompting and domain-specific baselines. Further scaffolder configuration analysis shows that dynamic difficulty alignment is critical for sustained capability improvement and synchronized reasoning evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出STRETCH统一框架，通过动态"拉伸区"机制持续对齐问题难度与模型能力，在单一参数空间内让同一模型在"脚手架"与"学习者"角色间交替，实现推理能力的持续自我提升。
AI.motivation: LLM在自我改进训练中常出现能力停滞，原因是固定难度的问题无法适应模型不断演进的解题能力，导致训练难度与能力不匹配。
AI.method: 受认知脚手架理论启发，设计动态Stretch Zone机制，持续将问题难度与模型当前解题能力对齐；在单一参数空间中，模型交替扮演Scaffolder（生成自适应的、处于能力边界的挑战题）与Learner（通过强化学习优化解题轨迹），形成双环协同演化。
AI.result: 在谈判（negotiation）与运筹学（operation research）基准测试上，STRETCH均稳定优于强提示方法与领域专用基线；脚手架配置分析进一步表明，动态难度对齐对持续的能力提升和推理同步演化至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 动态难度对齐是维持能力持续增长的关键；该双环共演化框架能稳定训练、缓解奖励劫持（reward hacking）并促进推理能力渐进式增长。

title: AeroWeaver: An Embodied-Agent Harness for Weaving Aerial Skills into Distributed, Adaptive Swarm Execution
summary: Collective intelligence is a collaborative autonomy paradigm in which multiple agents pursue shared objectives through local perception, information exchange, and coordinated action. UAV swarms embody this paradigm by coordinating multiple vehicles in tasks such as search, inspection, and tracking. Recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents have strengthened natural-language task understanding and high-level planning, providing a flexible semantic interface between mission descriptions and collective behavior. While these advances expand semantic reasoning, applying LLM agents to UAV swarms raises challenges in grounding model decisions in executable capabilities, reconciling global task reasoning with distributed execution, and using mission-specific experience for continual adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce AeroWeaver, an embodied-agent harness that weaves individual UAV skills into coordinated mission-level behavior. AeroWeaver connects semantic decisions to governed skills, organizes role-conditioned local agents for distributed coordination, and uses role-indexed state-action-reward experience to refine skill selection online. Experiments and runtime validation show that AeroWeaver maintains valid skill execution under tested conditions and supports body-local multi-UAV operation without a central agent generating joint actions from global context, while reward-guided online updates provide a training-free path for adaptive learning swarm agents from accumulated execution experience. Code: https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AeroWeaver，一种具身智能体框架，将无人机集群的个体技能编织为协同任务级行为，通过受治理技能、角色条件化局部智能体与角色索引经验实现在线自适应。

AI.method: AeroWeaver 作为具身智能体调度框架，将语义决策连接到受治理的技能库；组织角色条件化的局部智能体实现分布式协调；利用角色索引的状态-动作-奖励经验在线优化技能选择，无需训练即可自适应。
AI.result: 实验与运行时验证表明，AeroWeaver 在测试条件下可保持有效的技能执行，支持机体局部化的多无人机运行，无需中央智能体基于全局上下文生成联合动作；奖励引导的在线更新提供了免训练的自适应学习路径。

title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents
summary: Current Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) paradigms generally treat query routing and agent fine-tuning as separate processes, limiting their ability to respond to evolving agent capabilities. This disconnect prevents routing strategies from adapting to evolving agent capabilities during post-training and prevents agents from achieving synergistic data-driven specialization. To resolve this, we introduce CERA-MoA (Co-Evolving Router with continually learning Agents for Mixture-of-Agents), an iterative reinforcement learning framework where the dynamic router and independent agent policies co-evolve. We design a predictive familiarity estimator that leverages mid-layer hidden states to evaluate semantic competence among agents, avoiding the overhead of full rollouts. Based on these familiarity scores, a cumulative-threshold adaptive routing mechanism dynamically activates a tailored minimal agent subset, achieving a trade-off between task performance and efficiency. By proactively allocating targeted training samples to agents based on their evolving competence, CERA-MoA promotes capability differentiation. Extensive experiments across various domains demonstrate that CERA-MoA outperforms state-of-the-art static-agent routing and fix-workflow fine-tuning baselines.

AI.tldr: CERA-MoA 提出一种路由器与智能体策略协同演化的迭代强化学习框架，通过预测式熟悉度估计与累积阈值自适应路由，实现性能与效率的平衡并促进智能体能力分化。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoA 范式通常将查询路由与智能体微调视为分离过程，导致路由策略无法在训练过程中适应智能体能力的演化，也难以实现基于数据的协同专业化，限制了系统对能力变化的响应能力。
AI.method: 提出 CERA-MoA：动态路由器与各智能体独立策略协同演化的迭代强化学习框架。设计预测式熟悉度估计器，利用中层隐状态评估智能体间的语义胜任度，避免完整 rollout 开销；基于熟悉度分数，采用累积阈值自适应路由机制，动态激活最小的定制智能体子集；并根据智能体不断演化的能力主动分配针对性训练样本，促进能力分化。
AI.result: 在多个领域的广泛实验中，CERA-MoA 优于最先进的静态智能体路由方法与固定工作流微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 将路由与智能体训练统一为协同演化过程，可有效应对智能体能力的动态变化，在性能与效率之间取得更优权衡，并推动智能体的差异化与专业化。

title: Infinite-Parameter LLMs: Generating and Adapting Weights from Live Data
summary: The scaling laws hold that a language model grows more capable with more parameters and more training data, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have ridden these laws to remarkable results, activating only a fraction of an enormous stored parameter bank for each token. That success is built on static pretraining data. A deployed model faces a different world, where much of the data that would make it more useful is not in its training set but in the live interaction it is currently handling, such as the facts a user supplies or the corrections they give. A conventional model cannot learn from this data, because its weights are frozen after training. Instead, the knowledge and behaviour supplied at run time are placed in the prompt, by retrieval or instruction, and re-read on every request only to be discarded once the request ends. We ask how an architecture could learn from live interaction by writing it into its weights. Taking inspiration from MoE, we propose the \textbf{Infinite-Parameter LLM}. A compact hypernetwork turns the data given at run time into a low-rank modulation of a shared base network, so the feed-forward weights are generated from live data rather than stored in a fixed bank. Where prior weight generators read the context once and freeze, we carry a Bayesian belief over the generator's latent code and update it online, so the effective weight is re-derived from that evolving belief as the session proceeds rather than fixed after one read. The stored footprint stays fixed, yet the weights the model can compile are effectively infinite. For the knowledge and behaviour supplied at run time, carrying them in the weights rather than the prompt is amortized in compute, frees the context window, persists across turns, and can generalise better than in-context use. We specify an evaluation protocol that tests exactly this against in-context learning and retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出"无限参数LLM"：用小型超网络将运行时数据映射为共享基网络的低秩调制，并对生成器隐码维持在线更新的贝叶斯信念，使前馈权重由实时数据生成而非固定存储，在存储占用不变的情况下实现"有效无限"权重。
AI.motivation: Scaling law与MoE表明参数与数据越多模型越强，但这一成功建立在静态预训练数据上。部署后的模型权重冻结，无法从实时交互中学习（如用户提供的事实或纠正）；这些知识只能以检索或指令形式放入提示，每次请求重读一次即被丢弃，造成上下文窗口占用与算力不可摊销。
AI.method: 受MoE启发，设计紧凑超网络，把运行时给出的数据转换为对共享基网络的低秩调制，从而由实时数据生成前馈权重，取代固定参数库。与既有"读一次上下文即冻结"的权重生成器不同，本文对生成器隐码维持一个贝叶斯信念分布并在线更新，使有效权重随会话推进由该演化中的后验重新导出，而非一次性读取后固定。存储占用保持固定。
AI.result: 论文为架构与评估方案类工作，未报告实验数值结果；其主张的收益包括：将运行时知识与行为承载于权重而非提示，可在算力上摊销、释放上下文窗口、跨轮次持续保存，并可能比上下文内使用具有更好的泛化性。文中提出专门的评估协议，用于将这些性质与上下文学习及检索方法进行对照检验。
AI.conclusion: 把运行时交互知识写入权重、而非置于提示，是应对部署后数据分布漂移的一条可行路径；在固定存储预算下获得"有效无限"可编译权重，并使在线贝叶斯更新替代一次性权重生成。
