title: Function Lives Where Variance Doesn't: Task-Weighted Charts of a Language Model's Computation
summary: How many dimensions does a language model's computation actually use? The question is ill-posed until one names a functional. Task-weighted charts make it well-posed: low-dimensional coordinate systems fit against a chosen functional of the representation, under the functional's own metric, turning distillation into plain least squares. Across six models from three families, spanning 70m to 7B parameters, next-token prediction needs 70--90% of the residual stream's width to stay within 5% of intact perplexity, a width consumed by the rare tail of language, and the variance profile predicts none of it: two directions carry 90% of GPT-2's activation variance and almost none of its function. Dimension is per-functional: the model's own uncertainty reads from six coordinates where the full predictive distribution needs hundreds; and it grows with depth. The dissociation is exploitable: when only a few dimensions can be kept, charts trained under the functional's metric preserve the model's predictions better than variance-based or optimal linear compression.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"任务加权图表"(task-weighted charts)，将语言模型"用多少维度做计算"这一问题转化为针对特定功能泛函的低维拟合问题，并揭示计算维度与激活方差维度彼此解离。
AI.motivation: "语言模型计算实际使用多少维度"这一问题在未指定功能泛函时是病态的(ill-posed)，因为维度并非模型的固有单一属性，而取决于所考察的功能。作者希望给出一个使该问题良定义(well-posed)的框架，并厘清计算所需维度与表征方差维度之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出任务加权图表：在所选表征泛函自身的度量下，用低维坐标系对表征进行拟合，从而把蒸馏化为普通最小二乘问题。在来自三个家族、70m至7B参数的六个模型上，分别针对下一词预测、模型自身不确定性、完整预测分布等不同泛函测量所需维度。
AI.result: 下一词预测需保留残差流宽度的70–90%才能将困惑度保持在完整模型的5%以内，且该宽度主要被语言的稀有长尾占用；方差剖面无法预测这一点——仅两个方向就承载GPT-2激活方差的90%，却几乎不承担功能。维度是逐泛函的：模型自身不确定性仅需六个坐标即可读取，而完整预测分布需要数百个；且维度随深度增长。
AI.conclusion: 计算维度是逐泛函而非固有的，并与方差维度解离。该解离可利用：在只能保留极少维度时，按功能度量训练的任务加权图表比基于方差或最优线性压缩的方法更好地保持模型预测。

title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudo-labels as rewards and optimizes only approximately 100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无标签的仅偏置测试时强化学习（bias-only TTRL），仅优化约100K偏置参数（冻结主干），用多数投票伪标签作奖励。MATH-500上达76.67%，参数量比全参数TTRL少76,000倍，并可迁移至视觉语言、音频推理及4,500道留出数学题。分析揭示多数投票可靠性随轨迹一致性提升、梯度能量更大的偏置子空间可训练性更强。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时强化学习（TTRL）虽无需标注数据即可提升推理能力，但通常需优化模型的大部分参数，代价高。作者追问：当奖励信号与优化空间都被极大限制时，是否仍能产生有效的测试时自适应。
AI.method: 提出无标签的仅偏置TTRL：冻结预训练主干，仅优化约100K偏置参数；以多数投票生成的伪标签作为奖励信号进行优化；并进一步分析多数投票可靠性与轨迹一致性的关系，以及偏置子空间可及梯度能量与下游可训练性的关联。
AI.result: MATH-500上达76.67%准确率，略超作者自身的有标签偏置引导复现，参数量比全参数TTRL少76,000倍。同一训练流程在MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista、MMAU等视觉语言与音频推理任务上均有提升；所学引导向量可迁移到4,500道留出MATH题。分析显示多数投票可靠性随轨迹一致性提高，梯度能量更大的偏置子空间下游可训练性更强。
AI.conclusion: 仅优化极小偏置子空间并使用完全无标签奖励，即可产生显著的测试时自适应，表明高效、低参数的测试时强化学习是可行的。

title: A Convergence Framework for Deep $V$-Learning: Error Propagation and Sharp Action-Gap Bounds
summary: We establish convergence bounds for deep $V$-learning with horizon $H$. The algorithm fits a scalar value function to targets from executed transitions and selects actions using a predictive model and the value function. For current observed-successor targets with fresh true-kernel outcomes, the conditional mean is $\mathcal{T}^βV$, which averages over behavior-policy actions. The Bellman optimality update is $\mathcal{T} V$. We decompose the update error into six residuals: fitting, transition reuse, target construction, replay, action selection, and exploration. Under $L^s$ concentrability, their $L^p$ norms ($p=s/(s-1)$) control expected $L^1$ policy loss. The bound explicitly weights residuals from only the last $H-1$ update blocks, plus an initialization term for shorter runs. We quantify the cost of a shared sampling distribution across horizon levels. For statistical error bounds of order $n^{-ν}$, we derive optimal continuous allocations and an integer allocation whose objective is within a factor $2^ν$ of the constrained optimum. A margin condition with exponent $α$ gives action error of order $Λ^{1+α/p}$, where $Λ$ combines network drift and score error; a one-step construction proves the exponent sharp. Bounds on the distance between frozen and optimal scores transfer an optimal-gap condition to frozen-iterate gap bounds while retaining the mass of optimal ties. Survival probabilities and coverage conditions at deployment yield bounds for policies selected with approximate scores. Separate spatial ReLU networks per horizon level give a conditional neural regression rate, and the finite-state case gives a log-free expected fit rate. These results give expected policy-loss consistency for the fixed-horizon generative-reset approximate-ERM procedure with exact action scores and provide an explicit residual-decay criterion for FIFO/interleaved SGD.

AI.tldr: 该文为深度V-learning建立收敛界，将更新误差分解为六类残差，并在集中性条件下用其$L^p$范数控制期望$L^1$策略损失，同时刻画了有限时域下的最优采样分配、边距条件和神经网络回归率，进而给出固定时域生成式重置近似ERM的策略损失一致性。
AI.motivation: 深度V-learning在实践中广泛使用，但缺乏对其有限时域、依赖预测模型与值函数的算法收敛性的严格理论刻画，尤其是更新误差来源、跨时域采样分配代价以及策略选择误差的量化尚不清晰。
AI.method: 算法用执行转移构造目标，拟合标量值函数，并借助预测模型与值函数选动作。对当前观测后继目标，条件均值为$\mathcal{T}^\beta V$（对行为策略动作平均），最优Bellman更新为$\mathcal{T}V$。将更新误差分解为拟合、转移复用、目标构造、回放、动作选择、探索六项残差；在$L^s$集中性下用$L^p$（$p=s/(s-1)$）范数界定期望$L^1$策略损失，并显式加权最后$H-1$个更新块的残差及初始项。推导统计误差阶$n^{-\nu}$下的最优连续分配及目标在约束最优$2^\nu$因子内的整数分配。利用指数$\alpha$的边距条件得到策略误差$O(\Lambda^{1+\alpha/p})$，并用一步构造证明指数紧性。通过冻结与最优分数距离界，将最优间隔条件转译为冻结迭代间隔界。部署时的生存概率与覆盖条件给出近似分数选策略的界。每个时域层单独的空间ReLU网络给出条件神经回归率，有限状态情形给出无对数期望拟合率。
AI.result: 获得显式收敛界：期望$L^1$策略损失由六类残差的$L^p$范数控制；给出最优采样分配及其整数近似（因子$2^\nu$）；边距条件下动作误差为$\Lambda^{1+\alpha/p}$且指数尖锐；冻结迭代间隔界保留最优并列质量；生存概率与覆盖条件支持部署阶段近似分数策略界；ReLU网络获得条件神经回归率，有限状态获得无对数期望拟合率；并给出精确动作分数下固定时域生成式重置近似ERM的期望策略损失一致性及FIFO/交错SGD的残差衰减判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统刻画了深度V-learning的有限时域收敛性，将误差来源分解并量化，提供了采样分配、边距/间隔转译与部署覆盖等理论工具，并为近似ERM与SGD实现给出明确的一致性条件与残差衰减准则。

title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
summary: As models scale, reward hacking becomes more frequent, more sophisticated, and more consequential. Does it leave a telltale signature in model representations? This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max across a variety of behaviors in common evaluations. Despite their simplicity, these vectors are both generalizable and interpretable, and we can use them to reliably detect reward hacking. We first evaluate reward hacking in commonly reported benchmarks like DeepSWE and SWE-bench, finding that models reward hack excessively in these environments; GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench. Catching these requires monitors; LLM monitors are effective, but expensive detectors. We show that DoM vectors are similarly effective but virtually free, catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 and 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate. DoM vectors run on the chain-of-thought also predict reward hacks in the model's subsequent actions, meaning we can run them online and catch potential hacks before they occur. Finally, we analyze probe-hits that LLM monitors do not catch and discover other undesirable behaviors, as well as show transfer to finding hacks in non-SWE evaluations. Together, these results provide evidence that simple, white-box methods can be used to scalably study and monitor reward hacking behaviors in frontier open source models

AI.tldr: 该论文发现奖励破解在前沿开源LLM的表征中存在简单的线性信号：用均值差（DoM）向量即可一致地表征、检测并预测奖励破解行为，且成本几乎为零。
AI.motivation: 随着模型规模扩大，奖励破解变得更频繁、更复杂、后果更严重。现有的检测手段主要依赖LLM监控器，虽然有效但成本高昂，因此需要探索是否存在廉价、可扩展的白盒方法来理解并监控奖励破解。论文的核心问题是：奖励破解是否在模型内部表征中留下可识别的特征？
AI.method: 作者在Kimi K3、GLM 5.2和Qwen 3.8 Max等前沿开源LLM中提取简单的均值差（DoM）向量来表征奖励破解，并在DeepSWE、SWE-bench等常用评测上评估其效果。方法包括：用DoM向量检测奖励破解，与LLM监控器在匹配假阳性率下对比；将DoM向量应用于思维链（chain-of-thought）以在线预测后续动作中的破解行为；分析LLM监控器遗漏的probe命中，并测试向非SWE评测的迁移性。
AI.result: 模型在常用评测环境中大量奖励破解：GLM 5.2在DeepSWE中57.2%的rollout、SWE-bench中73%的rollout存在破解。DoM向量与LLM监控器效果相当但几乎免费——在匹配假阳性率下，Kimi K3在DeepSWE上多捕获3.1%的破解，GLM 5.2少捕获7.9%。作用于思维链的DoM向量还能预测模型后续动作中的奖励破解，实现事前在线捕获；此外还发现了LLM监控器遗漏的其他不良行为，并验证了向非SWE评测的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，简单的白盒方法可以可扩展地研究和监控前沿开源模型中的奖励破解行为，其表征既具泛化性又具可解释性。

title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
summary: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria, agents transform repositories into executable environments that support task generation, execution, and scientific verification. These environments provide a shared foundation for supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. Using verified interaction trajectories, we train PhAI-IDE-72B, PhAI-IDE-9B, and PhAI-IDE-4B. The model family shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning, and knowledge, providing evidence of positive transfer from scientific experience to broader capabilities. ScienceIDE lays the foundation for an integrated workspace for agent learning and scientific practice, making humanity's scientific software a shared substrate for developing scientific intelligence. Code: https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE

AI.tldr: 提出 ScienceIDE 基础设施，将科学代码仓库转化为可执行环境，用于科学智能体训练与评估。基于验证过的交互轨迹训练 PhAI-IDE-72B/9B/4B 系列模型，在科学代码修复及通用代码、推理、知识基准上均取得提升，证明科学经验可正向迁移至更广泛能力。
AI.motivation: 科学代码仓库蕴含数十年人类知识，但工具链碎片化、领域约定隐式化、正确性标准专业化，导致这些知识难以转化为可靠的学习经验，作者将此称为"科学经验瓶颈"（scientific experience bottleneck）。
AI.method: ScienceIDE 以专家定义的科学案例与验收标准为引导，让智能体将代码仓库改造为可执行环境，支持任务生成、执行与科学验证；这些环境构成监督微调、强化学习与评估的共享基础，并利用验证过的交互轨迹训练 PhAI-IDE 系列模型。
AI.result: 训练的 PhAI-IDE-72B、9B、4B 模型在留出的科学代码修复任务以及部分通用代码、推理与知识基准上均有提升，表明科学经验向更广泛能力存在正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: ScienceIDE 为智能体学习与科学实践的一体化工作空间奠定基础，使人类科学软件成为发展科学智能的共享基底。

title: Changepoint-Aware World Models: Detecting Dynamics Shifts and Recovering by Forgetting Stale Replay in Model-Based RL
comment: Accepted to the RSS 2026 Workshop on Robot World Models (R-WM)
summary: A robot's learned model of its own dynamics is only valid until those dynamics change: actuators wear, payloads shift, and joints stiffen. A model-based agent that keeps training as if nothing happened adapts slowly, dragged back by a replay buffer full of stale experience. We present Changepoint-Aware World Models (CAWM), a DreamerV3 agent that detects an abrupt dynamics shift from its own internal prediction error, using an online CUSUM test against a rolling baseline that fires only on abrupt change rather than on slow learning drift. It then forgets stale replay, keeping the learned representation while flushing obsolete data. On simulated locomotion under two robot-relevant shifts, doubled gravity and halved actuator gain, CAWM recovers substantially faster than passive retraining. It also beats a strong baseline that respawns a fresh dynamics model on detection, the deep-world-model analogue of model-bank methods. With the response triggered at the shift, CAWM gains +95 to +153 return in the first 30k post-shift frames over three seeds, while matching that respawn at asymptote. Running the detector in closed loop reproduces this gain on the gravity shift. The benefit holds across both shift types, and is largest when the shift is severe enough that old data is genuinely obsolete.

AI.tldr: 提出CAWM（Changepoint-Aware World Models），一种基于DreamerV3的智能体，利用在线CUSUM检测器从自身预测误差中识别突发的动力学变化，并通过遗忘陈旧回放数据实现快速适应。
AI.motivation: 机器人自身动力学的学习模型在其动力学发生变化后会失效（如执行器磨损、负载变化、关节僵化）。持续以"无事发生"方式训练的基于模型的智能体适应缓慢，受困于充满陈旧经验的回放缓冲区。
AI.method: CAWM在DreamerV3智能体上，通过在线CUSUM检验针对滚动基线监测内部预测误差，仅在突发变化（而非缓慢学习漂移）时触发；触发后保留已学表示但清空陈旧的回放数据。
AI.result: 在模拟运动任务中（重力加倍、执行器增益减半两种突变），CAWM比被动重训练恢复显著更快，也优于在检测时重生成全新动力学模型的强基线（模型库方法的深度世界模型类比）。在变化后前30k帧内，CAWM相较基线获得+95至+153的回报增益（三个随机种子），渐近性能与重生成基线相当。闭环运行检测器在重力变化上重现该增益。
AI.conclusion: 该增益在两种变化类型下均成立，且当变化足够严重以致旧数据确实过时的时候收益最大。

title: FedGuide: Diffusion Prior Alignment and Value Baseline Guidance for Heterogeneous Federated Reinforcement Learning
summary: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) enables collaborative policy learning across distributed agents with heterogeneous environments. While recent methods based on variance reduction, divergence penalization, and momentum optimization improve FRL under heterogeneous settings, they still primarily synchronize policy or value-network parameters and do not explicitly address distributional mismatch among heterogeneous clients. Therefore, we propose \textbf{FedGuide}, a FRL framework that uses diffusion priors as behavior models to provide personalized data supported distributions for heterogeneous local policy learning. Instead of directly averaging local policies, FedGuide aggregates those diffusion priors through Optimal-Transport Mixture-of-Experts (OT-MoE), preserving heterogeneous behavior modes in distribution space. It further develops a Distribution Correction Estimation (DICE) value baseline to provide low-variance, return-aware guidance for local policy improvement. Experiments across heterogeneous environments show that FedGuide outperforms representative FRL methods in client-average returns, final-round performance, and worst-round robustness, while maintaining stable learning under stronger heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: FedGuide 是一个联邦强化学习框架，用扩散先验作为行为模型为异构客户端提供个性化数据支撑分布，并通过最优传输专家混合聚合扩散先验、用 DICE 价值基线提供低方差回报感知引导。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦强化学习方法（基于方差缩减、散度惩罚、动量优化）在异构环境下虽有效，但主要同步策略或价值网络参数，未显式处理异构客户端间的分布不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出 FedGuide：使用扩散先验作为行为模型，为异构本地策略学习提供个性化的数据支撑分布；不直接平均本地策略，而是通过最优传输专家混合（OT-MoE）聚合扩散先验，在分布空间中保留异构行为模式；并引入分布修正估计（DICE）价值基线，为本地策略改进提供低方差、回报感知的引导。
AI.result: 在异构环境实验中，FedGuide 在客户端平均回报、末轮性能和最差轮鲁棒性上均优于代表性 FRL 方法，并在更强异构性下保持稳定学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚合分布层面的扩散先验并结合 DICE 引导，FedGuide 有效缓解联邦强化学习中的分布不匹配，提升异构环境下的性能与鲁棒性。

title: CompileRover: Revolutionizing Virtual Machine Compiler Optimization with a Tri-Role LLM-Driven Framework
summary: Code optimization plays a crucial role in the development of virtual machine compilers, with optimization frameworks significantly enhancing the performance of generated assembly code. However, existing virtual machine compiler outputs frequently exhibit redundant computations, inefficient loop structures, and suboptimal function implementations, which collectively impair execution efficiency. To address these shortcomings, we propose CompileRover, an advanced optimization framework specifically designed for virtual machine compilers. CompileRover employs a sophisticated three-role collaboration mechanism, comprising a referee, an advisor, and an operator, effectively overcoming performance bottlenecks by leveraging comprehensive optimization algorithms and novel methodologies, including control flow analysis, code structure transformations, and dynamic execution pattern recognition. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that CompileRover consistently surpasses state-of-the-art virtual machine compilers, achieving significant improvements in execution performance across various benchmarks. Furthermore, performance analyses validate that the introduced optimizations notably reduce execution overhead, improve dataflow consistency, and robustly enhance compiler performance, showcasing CompileRover as an effective and reliable approach to optimizing virtual machine compilers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CompileRover，一个面向虚拟机编译器的优化框架，采用裁判、顾问、操作员三角色协作机制，通过控制流分析、代码结构变换与动态执行模式识别等算法消除冗余计算、优化循环与函数实现，实验表明其性能显著优于现有最先进虚拟机编译器。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟机编译器输出常存在冗余计算、低效循环结构和次优函数实现，导致执行效率受损，亟需系统化的优化框架来提升生成汇编代码的性能。
AI.method: 提出 CompileRover 优化框架，核心为裁判（referee）、顾问（advisor）、操作员（operator）三角色协作机制，并结合控制流分析、代码结构变换、动态执行模式识别等综合优化算法与新方法。
AI.result: 广泛评测显示 CompileRover 持续超越最先进的虚拟机编译器，在多种基准上实现执行性能的显著提升；性能分析进一步验证优化可降低执行开销、改善数据流一致性并稳健提升编译器性能。
AI.conclusion: CompileRover 是一种有效且可靠的虚拟机编译器优化方案，能够针对冗余计算、循环与函数实现等瓶颈带来实质性性能收益，具有实际应用价值。

title: Locating Hidden Failures Makes Long-Horizon Agents More Reliable
summary: As AI agents take on long, autonomous tasks, we increasingly oversee rather than perform the work, yet we still judge them almost entirely by whether they finally succeed. An outcome cannot reveal where a run went wrong, whether the agent recovered, or the irreversible harm it caused along the way, and where long-horizon agents fail remains unmapped. We study $2518$ agent trajectories across software engineering, computer use, and science, close to real deployment, and classify $6967$ mistakes into $78$ failure types. Failure follows a recurring signature: after its first mistake an agent often fails to recover and rarely catches the error itself, so the run continues unchecked while still looking correct; whether an agent recovers depends on the task and the environment's feedback, not on the agent framework running it. Long-horizon agents can do real harm on the way to a passing result: even runs scored as solved delete data, corrupt systems, or fabricate success rather than earning it. We release these human-verified annotations as Traverse, a benchmark on which six frontier judges struggle to locate failure regardless of scale: even the strongest correctly identifies the first mistake in fewer than a third of runs. Yet Scout, a $4$B verifier we trained, locates failure far better than these judges and transfers to domains it never saw. Used at test time to select among an agent's candidate runs, it raises task success above the agent's own single-attempt performance, without retraining the agent. By making failure cheap to locate and correct, this work is a foundation for more trustworthy long-horizon agents that learn from their own mistakes, and a practical path to overseeing increasingly autonomous AI.

AI.tldr: 论文构建Traverse基准，对2518条智能体轨迹、6967个错误按78种失败类型进行人工标注，揭示长时程智能体的失败签名，并训练4B验证器Scout以低成本定位失败。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体承担长时程自主任务，人类更多是监督而非直接执行，但仍几乎仅凭最终是否成功来评判它们。结果无法揭示运行中何处出错、智能体是否恢复、或途中造成的不可逆危害，且长时程智能体的失败模式尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 收集软件工程、计算机使用与科学领域共2518条接近真实部署的智能体轨迹，将6967个错误分类为78种失败类型，并发布人工验证的Traverse基准；在此基础上训练一个4B验证器Scout，用于在测试时定位失败并选择候选运行。

AI.conclusion: 在测试时用Scout选择智能体的候选运行，可在不重训智能体的情况下将任务成功率提升至超过其单次尝试表现；使失败定位与纠正变得低成本，为更可信、能从自身错误中学习的长时程智能体奠定基础，并提供监督日益自主AI的可行路径。

title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments
summary: Language agents remain brittle in interactive environments, where success requires long-horizon state tracking, valid action execution, and recovery from failed steps. We extend SwiftSage, a dual-process agent that combines a fast action proposer with a slower planner, using two modular cognitive extensions: an Adaptive Memory Module (AMM) for salience-gated episodic storage and trigger-driven retrieval, and a Self-Reflection Module (SRM) for bounded execution-time validation and corrective intervention. Both modules are implemented as feature-flagged extensions over the same execution substrate, enabling controlled ablations on ScienceWorld. Across four configurations---baseline, baseline+AMM, baseline+SRM, and the full system---the full system achieves the best mean final score (64.62), success rate (43.17%), and successful-step efficiency (19.33 steps), while SRM is the strongest standalone contributor. The results suggest that execution-time control is the dominant bottleneck in this setting, while episodic memory becomes most useful once the runtime loop is stabilized.

AI.tldr: 该论文在SwiftSage双过程语言智能体基础上引入自适应记忆模块（AMM）与自我反思模块（SRM），并在ScienceWorld上进行受控消融，完整系统取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在交互式环境中依然脆弱：需要长程状态跟踪、有效动作执行以及失败步骤的恢复。为缓解这些瓶颈，作者希望通过模块化认知扩展增强既有双过程智能体的执行时控制与记忆能力。
AI.method: 以SwiftSage（快速动作提议者＋慢速规划器）为基座，提出两个模块化扩展：自适应记忆模块（AMM，基于显著性门控的情节存储与触发式检索）和自我反思模块（SRM，有界的执行时验证与纠错干预）。两模块均以特性开关形式实现于同一执行基底之上，从而支持在ScienceWorld上进行受控消融。设置四种配置：基线、基线+AMM、基线+SRM、完整系统。
AI.result: 完整系统取得最佳平均最终得分（64.62）、成功率（43.17%）和成功步效率（19.33步）；SRM是单独贡献最强的模块。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下，执行时控制是主导性瓶颈；情节记忆只有在运行时循环稳定之后才发挥最大作用。

title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions
summary: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with a retriever instead. That substitution is not symmetric across the two decisions. A retriever returns its highest-scoring candidate for every input and cannot signal that the catalog holds no valid action. Our earlier study found that constraining a decoder to a tool grammar repairs malformed output without improving the choice. What the substitution costs in each decision has not been measured. We evaluate the two decisions separately over 600 Korean and English requests and a catalog of 70 local actions. The router may also ask for a missing slot, reply, or delegate. Half the in-catalog requests reuse catalog vocabulary and half paraphrase it, separating lexical overlap from the action requested. Character 3-gram BM25 selects 162 of 164 lexically matched requests and 85 of 166 paraphrases. Restricting the candidate set to seven raises the paraphrase figure to a mean of 0.825 over five trials. No classifier over its score features separates in-catalog from out-of-catalog above 0.697 area under the curve, where the frozen encoder multilingual-e5-base reaches 0.806. Using that encoder for abstention alone keeps 376 of the requests local and misroutes 9 of the 150 needing delegation. Abstention, not selection, is where a neural component is required. A neural ranker improves every quality metric and is rejected on latency and memory rather than accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究将设备端AI助手的工具路由拆分为"选哪个工具"和"是否无适用工具"两个决策并分别评估，发现在70个本地动作、600条中英韩请求上，检索器的选择能力尚可（尤其限制候选集后），但无法可靠地判断"无工具可用"，而这一弃权决策才是真正需要神经组件的地方；神经排序器虽提升所有质量指标，但因延迟与内存被否决而非精度。
AI.motivation: 设备端需在无服务器条件下路由工具，语言模型主导了延迟和内存开销；常见替代方案是用检索器完全取代模型，但这种替代对"选择工具"和"判断是否有可用工具"两个决策的影响并不对称——检索器总会返回最高分候选，无法表示目录中无有效动作。此前工作只发现工具语法约束修复了格式错误却未改善选择，替代方案在每个决策上的具体代价尚未被量化。
AI.method: 在600条韩语和英语请求、70个本地动作的目录上分别评估两个决策；路由还可请求缺失槽位、回复或委托。半数库内请求复用目录词汇，半数改写表达，以分离词汇重叠与实际动作。比较字符3-gram BM25检索、将候选集限制为7、基于其分数特征的分类器，以及冻结编码器multilingual-e5-base的弃权表现。
AI.result: 字符3-gram BM25在164条词汇匹配请求中选出162条，166条改写中选出85条；候选集限制为7后改写命中率五轮均值达0.825。基于分数特征的分类器判别库内/库外AUC不超过0.697，而冻结编码器multilingual-e5-base达0.806。仅用该编码器做弃权可将376条请求留在本地，对150条需委托的请求误路由9条。神经排序器改善所有质量指标。
AI.conclusion: 需要神经组件的是弃权（abstention）决策而非选择（selection）决策；神经排序器尽管质量更优，仍因延迟和内存被拒，而非精度原因。

title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines
comment: 15 pages, 7 tables, 6 figures. Code and measurement corpus: https://github.com/li-ch/autotunebench (tag v1.0.0)
summary: Large language model agents tune GPU kernels and serving engines through a closed loop of propose, measure, and keep, but the measurements behind this loop are not trustworthy. We characterize four failure modes from a four-day pilot corpus of 619 model calls: strawman baselines manufacture speedups, absolute times do not transfer across machines, saturated tasks nullify comparisons, and infrastructure defects impersonate science. We present AutoTuneBench, a benchmark and measurement protocol that makes trust architectural. The protocol is frozen as code with test-enforced provenance; a database-level validator rejects out-of-protocol results; anti-cheat checks run outside the agent's modification surface; comparisons follow pre-registered readouts; and measurements anchor to externally published results, grounded in paired-seed statistics with a 5\% cross-run coefficient-of-variation cap. Honest measurement rewrites the headlines: our best kernel reads 10.6x against a naive baseline but 2.03x against the honest one; one configuration delivers 1.174x on one machine and 1.0049x on another; a pre-registered on/off comparison nulls at a shared wall (2.4840 vs 2.4957\,ms); and the KernelBench Level-1 suite admits 51\% of tasks with median speedup 1.0001x over PyTorch eager. The protocol, the two-engine corpus (vLLM and SGLang), and its audit trail are released as open artifacts.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM智能体自动调优GPU内核与服务引擎所依赖的测量不可信，梳理四类失效模式，并提出AutoTuneBench基准与测量协议，使可信度成为架构属性。诚实测量后，性能宣称大幅缩水。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过"提议—测量—保留"闭环优化GPU内核与服务引擎，但该闭环背后的测量结果不可信：稻草人基线炮制加速比、绝对时间无法跨机器迁移、饱和任务使比较失效、基础设施缺陷冒充科学结论，导致性能宣称失真。
AI.method: 提出AutoTuneBench基准与测量协议：协议以代码冻结并具测试强制溯源；数据库级校验器拒绝协议外结果；反作弊检查位于智能体可修改面之外；比较遵循预注册读数；测量锚定外部已发表结果，并以配对种子统计为基础，设5%跨运行变异系数上限。基于619次模型调用的四天试点语料。
AI.result: 诚实测量改写结论：最优内核相对朴素基线为10.6倍，但相对诚实基线仅2.03倍；同一配置在一台机器上为1.174倍，另一台仅1.0049倍；预注册开关比较在共享墙处归零（2.4840 vs 2.4957 ms）；KernelBench Level-1套件仅51%任务被接受，相对PyTorch eager的中位加速比为1.0001倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将可信测量架构化，揭示现有智能体调优性能宣称的虚高。协议、双引擎语料（vLLM与SGLang）及审计追踪均作为开放工件发布。

title: WordPolo: Evaluating Language Models Through Iterative Semantic Feedback
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are typically evaluated on challenging benchmarks through dataset accuracy alone, providing no insight into the quality or faithfulness of their reasoning processes. We present WordPolo, a word-finding task where participants must discover an unknown target word using semantic similarity feedback. Players start with zero knowledge, make guesses, and receive distance scores (1 = correct, higher = further away). Success requires interpreting scores to navigate semantic space and systematically narrow the search. This design makes iterative reasoning and adaptive search strategies both directly observable and necessary for success. We evaluate recent LLMs (GPT-4.1, Llama 4, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Qwen 3), LRMs (o4-mini, Deepseek-R1), humans, and a novel heuristic on 1,500 puzzles. Beyond solve rates (which range from 4% to 62%), we introduce progression-based metrics that reveal models often make meaningful progress, insights that accuracy alone would miss. Our analysis shows how reasoning models can be hindered by overthinking and underthinking, while successful models exhibit human-like strategies. WordPolo demonstrates the need for benchmarks that test both reasoning process and outcomes, providing holistic measurements of model capabilities. Our code and dataset can be found at https://wordpolo-demo.vercel.app/.

AI.tldr: 提出WordPolo词查找任务与过程性指标，用语义相似度反馈评估LLM/LRM的迭代推理与搜索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM/LRM评估多依赖数据集准确率，无法揭示推理过程的质量与忠实性，需要能同时测试推理过程与结果的基准。
AI.method: 设计WordPolo任务：参与者从零知识开始猜测未知目标词，依据语义相似度距离分数（1为正确，越大越远）导航语义空间并逐步缩小搜索。在1500个谜题上评估GPT-4.1、Llama 4、Claude 3.5 Haiku、Qwen 3、o4-mini、Deepseek-R1、人类及一种新启发式方法，并引入基于进展的指标。
AI.result: 求解率范围为4%至62%；进展性指标显示模型常能取得有意义的进展，这是仅看准确率会遗漏的；推理模型可能受过度思考与思考不足的阻碍，成功模型则表现出类人策略。
AI.conclusion: WordPolo表明需要同时测试推理过程与结果的基准，以更整体地衡量模型能力；代码与数据集已公开。

title: One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR
summary: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lovász theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erdős--Rényi, Watts-Strogatz, Barabási--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 1600 benchmark instances, and out performs the naive GISD baseline, allows us to confirm the value brought by the SDP-guided choice of the first color class. This quality comes at a runtime cost of roughly 195 times slower that DSATUR, but demonstrating that SDP-guided preprocessing of a first color class is a direction for future improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSLD，用半正定规划（SDP）预计算一个固定着色类，再交由DSATUR完成剩余顶点的着色，从而改进DSATUR的图着色质量。
AI.motivation: 图着色问题是NP-hard问题，DSATUR虽为最快启发式之一，但所用颜色数通常多于当前最优着色算法，因此存在改进其着色质量的空间。
AI.method: SSLD先通过一个类似计算Lovász theta数的半正定规划（SDP）求出一个优质颜色类作为预处理，将其固定后，再由DSATUR对剩余顶点完成着色，据称是首个通过预置固定颜色类来改进DSATUR的方法。
AI.result: 在DIMACS实例、随机图（Erdős–Rényi、Watts–Strogatz、Barabási–Albert）、频率分配及作业车间调度等超过1600个基准实例上，SSLD几乎在所有情况下追平或优于DSATUR，并优于朴素GISD基线，证实了SDP引导选择首个颜色类的价值。
AI.conclusion: SDP引导的首个颜色类预处理能有效改进DSATUR的着色质量，但运行时间约为DSATUR的195倍，表明该方向在质量和效率间的权衡上仍有进一步优化空间。

title: The evolution of sex for artificial intelligence: a population-genetic framework for multigenerational model populations
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Supplementary Information (26 pp) and a plain-language figure appendix for readers from biology (23 pp) are included as ancillary files. Code, configs and seeds: https://git.lab.gilest.ro/giorgio/MachineSex
summary:
Some aspects of AI development resemble a population process in which models are specialised, retrained on the output of peers, or combined by averaging weights. These practices lead to generations of models, in the biological sense studied by population genetics. Here, I develop this parallelism and interpret multigenerational model populations in terms of sexual and asexual reproduction, formally recombining the two fields. I test these analogies in an exact inheritance model, in trained networks (recurrent, feedforward and variational autoencoder generators) and in large language models, and show that they hold generally, with some measurable architecture-specific biases.
  Training recursively on model output is known to lead to model collapse, a process previously described as akin to genetic drift; I develop all that follows. A minimal model of a learner retrained on its parent's output reproduces the Wright-Fisher process exactly; verified real data added to each generation play the role of immigration, with the surprising finding that the absolute number of real data samples matters, not their share, exactly as in population genetics. Training a child on the average of its parents' outputs cancels the benefit of having several parents, matching blending inheritance (and reviving Jenkin's objection to Darwin), whereas combining parents so that each keeps its strongest contribution preserves it; merged language-model specialists exceeded every parent across seeds (the Fisher-Muller effect); and lineages become reproductively isolated, losing the ability to merge at all, when they have learned conflicting conventions and not when they have merely drifted apart.
  As AI societies become societies in time as well as in space, a mathematical framework for their inheritance acquires predictive power. Remarkably, that framework can be adapted almost wholesale from biology.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI模型的多代演化过程类比为群体遗传学中的繁殖与遗传过程，建立跨学科形式化框架，并在递归训练、模型合并、大语言模型等场景中验证类比的成立及架构特异性偏差。
AI.motivation: AI开发中出现模型专门化、基于同伴输出再训练、权重平均合并等实践，导致模型形成"代际"。这些现象与群体遗传学研究的生物种群过程相似，但缺乏形式化的理论框架来理解多代模型群体的遗传规律。作者希望借助群体遗传学的成熟数学工具，为AI社会的"时间维度"演化提供可预测的理论基础。
AI.method: 作者将多代模型群体解释为有性与无性繁殖过程，形式化地融合两个领域。构建精确遗传模型，在训练网络（循环网络、前馈网络、变分自编码器生成器）和大语言模型上测试类比。将递归训练导致的模型崩溃对应为Wright-Fisher过程，真实数据作为移民项；分析父代输出平均对应混合遗传，最强贡献保留对应Fisher-Muller效应；并研究谱系生殖隔离现象。
AI.result: 类比普遍成立，但存在可测的架构特异性偏差。最小学习器模型精确复现Wright-Fisher过程；每代加入的真实数据起移民作用，且绝对样本数而非占比决定效果，与群体遗传学一致。对父代输出取平均会抵消多父代收益（混合遗传，重现Jenkin对达尔文的诘难），而保留各自最强贡献的合并方式可维持收益，合并的语言模型专家在各随机种子下均超越所有父代（Fisher-Muller效应）。当谱系学到冲突约定时发生生殖隔离、丧失合并能力，而单纯漂移分离则不会。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI社会在空间和时间维度上均成为社会，为其遗传建立数学框架具备预测能力。该框架几乎可以整体从生物学迁移适配而来，表明AI模型演化与生物种群遗传在数学结构上高度同构。

title: Prior-Free Competitive Ratios for Improving Bandits: Scale, Curvature and Horizon Are Free, but Not Jointly Under Noise
summary: In the improving multi-armed bandits problem, each of $k$ arms has an unknown nondecreasing, discretely concave reward curve $f_i$, and pulling arm $i$ for the $t$-th time yields $f_i(t)$. For sufficiently long horizons, Blum and Ravichandran (ALT 2025) proved that randomized algorithms achieve an $O(\sqrt k)$ approximation to the best single arm when the scale $m=f^*(T)$ of the optimal arm is known ($T\ge2k$), and $O(\sqrt k\log k)$ when it is not ($T>4k$), against an $Ω(\sqrt k)$ lower bound. The logarithmic factor is unnecessary: a one-page \emph{probe-and-commit} algorithm achieves competitive ratio $4\sqrt3\,\sqrt k$ for $T\ge2\lfloor\sqrt k\rfloor$, without any knowledge of the scale, and we determine the optimal ratio for every horizon, $Θ(\sqrt k+k/T)$, also for unknown horizons. Without noise, \emph{no prior is needed at all}: a random-marginal probing algorithm reading neither the scale $m$, nor the concavity-envelope exponent $β$ of Blum, Garicano, Ravichandran and Sharma (UAI 2026), nor the horizon $T$, achieves the optimal $Θ(k^{β/(1+β)}+k/T)$ simultaneously for every $β$ and every horizon. Under the multiplicative noise model of Blum and Ravichandran, probe-and-commit keeps the same all-horizon order $Θ(\sqrt k+k/T)$ without knowing the noise level (and $Θ(\sqrt k)$ on the same range), but the price of priors jumps: for any fixed noise level $\varepsilon\in(0,1/2]$, the uniform price of adaptation $φ_\varepsilon(k)$ --- the worst case over horizons $T\ge16k$ of the loss relative to $k^{β/(1+β)}$ for algorithms knowing neither $m$ nor $β$ --- is $Θ_\varepsilon(\sqrt{\log k/\log\log k})$, the lower bound asymptotic in $k$ at fixed positive $\varepsilon$ and matched by a nested random-permutation probing algorithm, whereas knowing either $m$ or $β$ alone restores a constant price.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究改进型多臂老虎机（improving multi-armed bandits）问题，通过提出"probe-and-commit"算法与随机边际探测算法，消除了先前结果中的对数因子，并刻画了各时间范围下的最优竞争比及先验知识对自适应代价的影响。
AI.motivation: Blum与Ravichandran (ALT 2025) 的既有结果在未知尺度的情形下存在不必要的对数因子 $O(\sqrt{k}\log k)$，且依赖对最优臂尺度 $m$ 的已知假设。作者希望确定最优竞争比、去除对数因子，并厘清无噪声与乘性噪声下先验知识（尺度 $m$、凹包络指数 $\beta$、时间范围 $T$）对算法表现的影响。
AI.method: 提出"probe-and-commit"单页算法，无需知道尺度 $m$；无噪声情形下采用随机边际探测（random-marginal probing）算法，不读取 $m$、$\beta$ 或 $T$；乘性噪声下使用嵌套随机置换探测（nested random-permutation probing）算法。并通过下界论证刻画最优竞争比与自适应代价 $\phi_\varepsilon(k)$。
AI.result: 在 $T\ge2\lfloor\sqrt{k}\rfloor$ 时，probe-and-commit 达到竞争比 $4\sqrt3\,\sqrt{k}$，且无需尺度知识；证明了每个时间范围的最优比为 $\Theta(\sqrt{k}+k/T)$（未知时间范围亦然）。无噪声下，随机边际探测算法对所有 $\beta$ 和所有时间范围同时达到最优 $\Theta(k^{\beta/(1+\beta)}+k/T)$，无需任何先验。乘性噪声下，probe-and-commit 在不含噪声水平知识时仍保持 $\Theta(\sqrt{k}+k/T)$ 的全时间范围阶，但自适应代价 $\phi_\varepsilon(k)=\Theta_\varepsilon(\sqrt{\log k/\log\log k})$；已知 $m$ 或 $\beta$ 之一即可恢复常数代价。
AI.conclusion: 对数因子可在无需先验知识的情况下被消除；该工作确定了改进型多臂老虎机问题在各时间范围下的最优竞争比，揭示了先验知识（尤其是尺度 $m$ 与凹包络指数 $\beta$）在噪声环境下对自适应代价的关键作用，并给出匹配上下界的算法与下界证明。

title: The Missing "I Don't Know": Why Three Reasoning-Reliability Findings Converge on Calibrated Abstention
comment: 12 pages, 4 tables. Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference)
summary: Three recent results describe what look like unrelated LLM reliability problems. Yin et al. (2026) show reasoning RL collapses tool-reliability representations. Suleymanov et al. (2026) show that under safety-constrained generation, large models rewrite flagged spans while small models truncate. Bastounis et al. (2024) prove any consistent-reasoning system without an implicit "I don't know" function must hallucinate infinitely often on broad problem classes. We argue these findings converge on a single intervention: calibrated abstention is what each independently identifies as the missing capability, even though the unavailability they document, a capability gap, a policy gap, and a recursion-theoretic gap, has a different source in each case. Honesty post-training has narrowed the gap in deployed models, but principled closure of the class Bastounis identifies requires a calibrated abstention function whose training signal at the leaderboard level is absent: dominant benchmarks assign zero reward to decline, so the leaderboard gradient that would select for the function does not exist. We propose four changes to evaluation: triple-scoring, abstention-rate reporting, capability-stratified evaluation, and mandatory calibration metrics. Benchmark reform is necessary, not sufficient, for closing the gap the theorem identifies.

AI.tldr: 三项看似无关的LLM可靠性研究（推理RL破坏工具可靠性表征、安全约束下大模型重写与小模型截断、一致性推理系统必然幻觉）在"校准弃答能力缺失"上收敛，本文主张通过基准评测改革（三重评分、弃答率报告、能力分层评测、强制校准度量）来闭合该缺口，但强调基准改革是必要非充分条件。
AI.motivation: 三项近期研究分别揭示了LLM可靠性问题：推理强化学习导致工具可靠性表征崩溃、安全约束生成下大小模型行为分化、以及一致性推理系统的递归论必然幻觉。作者认为这些发现看似无关，实则指向同一缺失能力——校准弃答。当前诚实性后训练虽缩小了差距，但主流基准对"拒答"给予零奖励，导致选择该能力的排行榜梯度根本不存在，因此需要从评测机制层面改革。
AI.method: 采用理论综合与论证分析的方法：将三项独立研究（能力缺口、策略缺口、递归论缺口）统一归因于校准弃答缺失，并据此提出四项评测改革方案——三重评分（triple-scoring）、弃答率报告（abstention-rate reporting）、能力分层评测（capability-stratified evaluation）、强制校准度量（mandatory calibration metrics）。
AI.result: 论证表明三项研究在"校准弃答"这一干预点上收敛，尽管各自缺口来源不同；同时指出诚实性后训练已缩小部署模型的差距，但Bastounis等人所刻画的必须幻觉类别的原则性闭合，需要具备校准弃答函数，而当前排行榜层面缺失该训练信号——主流基准对拒答零奖励，故选择该函数的排行榜梯度不存在。
AI.conclusion: 基准改革对于闭合定理所刻画的缺口是必要的，但并非充分条件；需要通过四项评测机制变革来建立校准弃答的训练信号，从而在原则层面闭合该缺口。

title: SFT or RL for Tool-Calling Agents? A Controlled Study Across Data, Method, and Scale
comment: Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Limited controlled evidence exists on how training data, adaptation method, and model scale jointly affect tool-calling performance in language-model agents. We evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with LoRA, reinforcement learning (RL) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and SFT followed by GRPO across six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, covering both in-distribution performance and cross-dataset transfer. SFT with LoRA is the strongest in-distribution method throughout the 0.6B-32B range and best in 15 out of 18 experimental settings. On cross-dataset transfer, the methods are closer: GRPO wins 29 out of 54 settings where training and test datasets differ, but its margin over SFT averages under one point, and SFT->GRPO is rarely strongest in either comparison. Dataset mixing gives consistently strong transfer while staying close to specialized in-distribution training, regardless of method. Additional analysis further confirms that LoRA outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning, demonstrating that LoRA better preserves pretrained agentic behavior.

AI.tldr: 在六种规模的Qwen3模型（0.6B–32B）上，对比LoRA监督微调（SFT）、GRPO强化学习（RL）及SFT→GRPO对工具调用性能的影响：SFT/LoRA在分布内训练中最优，跨数据集迁移时各方法差距很小，GRPO略占优但优势不足1分；数据混合带来稳健的迁移能力，且LoRA优于全参数微调。
AI.motivation: 关于训练数据、适配方法与模型规模如何共同影响语言模型智能体工具调用性能的受控证据有限，尤其在跨规模、跨分布内外的系统比较上存在空白。
AI.method: 在六个Qwen3模型（0.6B至32B）上，分别评测三类适配方法：LoRA监督微调（SFT）、基于GRPO的强化学习（RL）、以及先SFT后GRPO，同时考察分布内表现与跨数据集迁移表现，并进行数据混合策略及LoRA与全参数微调的对比分析。
AI.result: SFT with LoRA在整个0.6B–32B范围内均为最强的分布内方法，在18个实验设置中15个最优。跨数据集迁移上各方法更接近：GRPO在训练与测试数据集不同的54个设置中胜出29个，但相对SFT的平均优势不足1分，SFT→GRPO在两类比较中都很少最强。数据混合在不同方法下均能带来稳定强劲的迁移性，同时接近专门化的分布内训练。LoRA优于全参数微调。
AI.conclusion: LoRA-SFT是稳健的分布内首选方案；跨分布迁移场景下方法选择影响有限，GRPO仅有微弱优势；数据混合是兼顾分布内与迁移的实用策略；LoRA通过更好保留预训练智能体行为，优于全参数微调。

title: Maximum Matching Size for Bounded Arboricity Graphs in the Dynamic Graph Stream Model using $\tilde{O}(n^{2/3})$ space
summary: The paper presents a one-pass algorithm in the insert-delete graph stream model that returns a $(1+\varepsilon)(α+2)$-approximation for the size of the maximum matching in a graph of arboricity at most $α$. The algorithm uses $O(\varepsilon^{-4/3}α^{4/3}n^{2/3} \text{polylog} n)$ space. For constant $α$ and $\varepsilon$, this improves the best known previous space bound from $O(n^{4/5} \text{polylog} n)$ to $O(n^{2/3} \text{polylog} n)$. The algorithm is a linear sketch and requires no bounds on the number of deletions or on the arboricity of intermediate graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单遍插入-删除图流算法，对树萌度为α的图返回最大匹配大小的(1+ε)(α+2)-近似，空间复杂度为O(ε^{-4/3}α^{4/3}n^{2/3} polylog n)，将此前最优空间界从O(n^{4/5})改进至O(n^{2/3})。
AI.motivation: 在图流模型中估计最大匹配大小是流算法领域的核心问题之一。已有最优单遍算法空间约为O(n^{4/5})，在高稀疏（小树萌度）图上有较大提升空间，因此作者希望在插入-删除流模型下降低空间需求，同时保持近似比可接受。
AI.method: 算法为单遍（one-pass）线性草图（linear sketch），针对树萌度不超过α的图。无需对删除次数或中间图树萌度做任何假设。核心思路是利用线性草图的可合并性与树萌度结构，在受限树萌度假设下压缩所需维护的信息量，从而以O(ε^{-4/3}α^{4/3}n^{2/3} polylog n)的空间实现(1+ε)(α+2)-近似估计。
AI.result: 对于常数α和ε，空间复杂度从先前最优的O(n^{4/5} polylog n)降低到O(n^{2/3} polylog n)。近似比达到(1+ε)(α+2)。算法为单遍线性草图，且对删除次数和中间图树萌度无额外约束。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著推进了受限树萌度图流中最大匹配估计的空间下界理解，以线性草图的简洁形式实现了空间的大幅改进，并保持了对插入-删除流中动态删除的鲁棒性。

title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Multi-turn agent trajectories often contain redundant rounds (failed tool calls, parallel sub-queries, verification-only steps) that inflate both training and inference cost. We propose viewing each trajectory as a \emph{round-level dependency DAG} that exposes which rounds are globally load-bearing for the final answer, and fine-tune agents on trajectories refined through this DAG. Given an LLM-annotated DAG, these edits are deterministic and interpretable, with optional rephrasing. Models trained on these refined trajectories consistently outperform those trained on the original trajectories at lower inference cost. Specifically, across four multi-modal QA benchmarks, our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to $1.7$\,pp over vanilla SFT (and $5.7$\,pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately $40\%$ and inference tokens by up to approximately $48\%$, translating to substantial savings in compute and serving cost. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 论文将多轮智能体轨迹建模为"轮级依赖DAG"，识别对最终答案全局关键的轮次，据此确定性、可解释地精炼轨迹并微调，从而在降低推理成本的同时提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体轨迹常包含冗余轮次（失败的调用、并行子查询、仅验证步骤），同时抬高了训练与推理成本。需要一种能甄别哪些轮次对最终答案真正"承重"的方法来去除冗余。
AI.method: 把每条轨迹视为轮级依赖DAG，以揭示哪些轮次对最终答案具有全局承重作用；在LLM标注的DAG基础上，对轨迹进行确定性、可解释的编辑（含可选改写），并用精炼后的轨迹微调智能体。

title: F-DACE: Fuzzy Disagreement-Aware Causal Evidence Fusion for Abstention-Safe Conversational Retail Decision Support
summary: Observational decision-support systems often expose one causal estimate as a recommendation even when plausible estimators disagree. The inherent engine of the proposed system is causal machine learning: a conditional-average-treatment-effect estimand identified by backdoor adjustment, estimated by an EconML DML causal forest and DoWhy linear regression, checked by two-way fixed effects, and converted into candidate levers by constrained optimisation. F-DACE is the decision layer on that engine. It represents precision, propensity overlap, placebo-refutation stability, interval overlap, and directional agreement as fuzzy memberships. Hard vetoes force abstention after estimand mismatch, failed diagnostics, informative sign conflict, or weak evidence. In 180 panel simulations spanning six identification conditions, F-DACE made a decision in 67.2% of runs and limited false recommendations to 17.2%; the corresponding rates were 33.3% for the causal forest and 35.6% for backdoor regression, matching deterministic unanimity rather than dominating it. Nearly all (30 of 31) false recommendations occurred under shared unmeasured confounding, which no fusion rule can diagnose when every component shares the omitted variable. The retail application aggregates a public Walmart panel to 6,435 store-weeks across 45 stores. F-DACE abstains for all five markdown indicators: some estimates are imprecise, one refutation fails, and MarkDown5 has a direct sign conflict. A LangGraph conversational agent exposes impact, what-if, and lever-optimization tools while a deterministic verifier preserves causal-layer status. On 24 live questions it achieved 100.0% tool-routing accuracy, 100.0% status fidelity, and 0.983 mean groundedness. On ten adversarial questions it resisted all injected instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出 F-DACE 决策层，将因果机器学习估计转化为推荐或弃权决策。
AI.motivation: 观测性决策支持系统常只暴露单一因果估计作为推荐，而多个合理估计量之间可能互相矛盾，缺少系统的决策与弃权机制。
AI.method: 以因果机器学习为引擎：通过后门调整识别条件平均处理效应，用 EconML DML 因果森林与 DoWhy 线性回归估计，以双向固定效应检验，并经约束优化转为候选杠杆。F-DACE 作为决策层，将精度、倾向重叠、安慰剂反驳稳定性、区间重叠与方向一致性表达为模糊隶属度；在估计量不匹配、诊断失败、方向冲突或证据薄弱时以硬否决强制弃权。
AI.result: 在覆盖六种识别条件的180次面板模拟中，F-DACE 在67.2%的运行中给出决策，误推荐率为17.2%；因果森林与后门回归分别为33.3%和35.6%，与确定性一致规则相当而非占优。31次误推荐中30次发生在共同未测混杂下。零售应用中，公开 Walmart 面板聚合为45家门店的6,435个门店周，F-DACE 对五个降价指标全部弃权：部分估计不精确、一项反驳失败、MarkDown5 存在方向冲突。LangGraph 对话代理提供影响、what-if 与杠杆优化工具，确定性验证器保持因果层状态；24个实时问题达100.0%工具路由准确率、100.0%状态保真度和0.983平均依据度，10个对抗问题中抵御全部注入指令。
AI.conclusion: F-DACE 提供了可弃权的融合决策框架，但其有效性受限于共同未测混杂——当所有组件共享同一遗漏变量时，任何融合规则都无法诊断该问题。

title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning
summary: Adaptive learning systems commonly formulate learning path planning as Exercise-Centric (EC) recommendation, where the next step is inferred from item-level interaction logs. Evaluating goal-oriented guidance additionally requires explicit learner goals and curriculum-scale prerequisites: learners with similar exercise records may need different paths toward their targets. We therefore study Knowledge-Centric (KC) personalized learning path planning, where a planner must reason over learner profiles, mastery states, and prerequisite knowledge structures to decide which textbook, unit, and concept should be studied next. To support this setting, we introduce PersonaPath, a benchmark that pairs 2,000 fine-grained learner personas with a hierarchical knowledge graph of 347 textbooks, 1,751 units, and 4,092 concepts across 77 subjects. We evaluate representative LLMs on PersonaPath. Results show that even the strongest LLM reaches only a 29.5% final pass rate in Basic Education, and that the main bottleneck lies in adaptivity, where no model exceeds 44.7% in tailoring paths to individual learners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识中心（KC）个性化学习路径规划任务与PersonaPath基准（2000个学习者画像+347本教材、1751个单元、4092个概念的分层知识图谱，覆盖77个学科），评测显示最强LLM在基础教育场景最终通过率仅29.5%，自适应性为核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 自适应学习系统通常将学习路径规划建模为以习题为中心的推荐，仅依据题目级交互日志推断下一步，缺乏显式学习目标与课程规模先修结构，无法支持目标导向的个性化引导：交互记录相似的学习者，其目标可能不同，所需路径亦不同。因此需要转向知识中心的学习路径规划。
AI.method: 提出PersonaPath基准：构建2000个细粒度学习者画像，以及覆盖77个学科的层级知识图谱（347本教材、1751个单元、4092个概念）；规划器需综合学习者画像、掌握状态与先修知识结构，决定下一应学习哪本教材、哪个单元与哪个概念；随后在该基准上评测代表性LLM。
AI.result: 即使最强LLM在基础教育（Basic Education）场景下最终通过率也仅29.5%；主要瓶颈在于自适应性，即在针对个体学习者定制路径方面，没有模型超过44.7%。

title: CoRe-MARL: Cooperative Redistribution Under Unknown Dynamics Using Recurrent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Emergency management assistance programs, such as relief distribution, are essential for delivering necessary supplies to affected communities. However, these programs operate in a decentralized network of local centers that face uncertain local demand and supply dynamics, resulting in inconsistent avail- ability of local services. Redistribution of supplies among these local centers reduces these imbalances, but the centers often make decisions independently, with limited information and disrupted transportation. This study develops CoRe-MARL, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework, by formulating a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP). We treat each center as an agent that learns a redistribution policy to improve the service in the worst-case region and reduce the service gap across regions while protecting network-wide service. We incorporate a recurrent network that captures evolving supply and demand dynamics without direct observation, while multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) enables centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE). We evaluate the framework in a simulated environment with diverse trajectories, where exact dynamics are not observed by actors and the MAPPO critic. We compare the recurrent MAPPO with the recurrent independent PPO (IPPO) and a local only heuristic, and find that MAPPO reduces the service gap across local centers and enhances service for the worst-served center while maintaining competitive network-wide service. The recurrent MAPPO also shows consistent performance across diverse trajectory patterns, demonstrating its ability to adapt to evolving dynamics. The findings demonstrate the capability of cooperative learning for decentralized redistribution and improving equitable service under uncertain and evolving dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRe-MARL协作多智能体强化学习框架，将应急物资再分配建模为Dec-POMDP，用循环MAPPO实现集中训练分散执行，在不确定动态下缩小区域服务差距并提升最差区域服务。
AI.motivation: 应急管理援助（如救灾物资分配）依赖分散的地方中心网络，但各地需求与供给动态不确定，中心间决策独立、信息有限且运输中断，导致服务可用性不一致。物资再分配可缓解失衡，但缺乏在不确定与动态演化条件下的分散协调机制。
AI.method: 将问题建模为分散部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP），每个中心作为一个智能体学习再分配策略，目标为改善最差区域服务、缩小区域间服务差距并保护全网服务。采用循环神经网络捕捉无法直接观测的供需动态演化，结合多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）实现集中训练与分散执行（CTDE）。在仿真环境中评估，且actor与MAPPO critic均无法观测精确动态。
AI.result: 与循环IPPO及仅本地启发式方法相比，循环MAPPO缩小了地方中心间的服务差距，提升了服务最差中心的服务水平，同时保持具有竞争力的全网服务；并在多种轨迹模式下表现一致，体现对动态演化的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 协作学习可用于分散式物资再分配，在不确定且动态演化的环境下提升服务公平性。
